items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃е, хвалы̀ моея̀ не премолчѝ: я҆́кѡ оу҆ста̀ грѣ́шнича, и̑ оу҆ста̀ льсти́ваго на́ мя ѡ̑тверзо́шася. Глаго́лаша на́ мя язы́комъ льсти́вымъ, и̑ словесы̀ ненави́стными ѡ̑быдо́ша мя̀: и̑ бра́шася со мно́ю тꙋ́не. Въ мѣ́сто любвѐ ѡ̑болга́хꙋ мя̀: а҆́зъ же мл҃твꙋ дѣ́яхъ. И̑ положи́ша на́ мя зла̑я за бл҃га̑я, и̑ не́нависть за возлюблє́нїе моѐ. Поста́ви на́нь грѣ́шника, и̑ дїа́волъ да ста́нетъ ѡ̑деснꙋ́ю є҆гѡ̀. Внегда̀ сꙋди́ти є҆мꙋ̀, да и̑зы́йдетъ ѡ̑сꙋжде́нъ: и̑ мл҃тва є҆гѡ̀ бꙋ́ди въ грѣ́хъ. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ дні́е є҆гѡ̀ ма́ли, и̑ є҆пи́скопию є҆гѡ̀ да прїи́метъ и̑́нъ. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ сы́нове є҆гѡ̀ си́ри, и̑ жена̀ є҆гѡ̀ вдова̀. Дви́жащеся преселя́тся сы́нове є҆гѡ̀, и̑ да воспро́сятъ: да и̑згна́ни бꙋ́дꙋтъ и̑зъ домо́въ свои́хъ. Да взы́щетъ заимода́вецъ вся̑ є҆ли́ка сꙋ́ть є҆гѡ̀: и̑ да восхи́тятъ чꙋ́ждїи трꙋды̀ є҆гѡ̀. Да не бꙋ́детъ є҆мꙋ̀ застꙋ́пника, ниже́ да бꙋ́детъ оу҆щедря́яй сироты̑ є҆гѡ̀. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ ча̑да є҆гѡ̀ въ па́гꙋбꙋ: въ ро́дѣ є҆ди́номъ да потреби́тся и̑́мя є҆гѡ̀. Да воспомяне́тся беззако́нїе ѻ҆те́цъ є҆гѡ̀ пред Гдⷭ҇емъ, и̑ грѣ́хъ ма́тере є҆гѡ̀ да не ѡ̑чи́стится. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ проти́вꙋ Гдⷭ҇у вы́ну, и̑ да потреби́тся ѿ земля̀ па́мять и̑́хъ: зане́же не помянꙋ̀ сотвори́ти мл҃ть. И̑ погна̀ человѣ́ка ни́ща и̑ оу҆бо́га, и̑ смире́нна се́рдцемъ є҆́же оу҆мертви́ти. И̑ возлюбѝ кля́твꙋ, и̑ прїи́детъ є҆мꙋ̀: и̑ не восхотѣ̀ благослове́нїя, и̑ оу҆дали́тся ѿ негѡ̀. И̑ ѡ̑блече́ся въ кля́твꙋ я҆́кѡ въ ри́зꙋ, и̑ вни́де я҆́кѡ вода̀ во оу҆тро́бꙋ є҆гѡ̀, и̑ я҆́кѡ є҆ле́й въ кѡ́сти є҆гѡ̀. Да бꙋ́детъ є҆мꙋ̀ я҆́кѡ ри́за, въ ню́же ѡ̑блачи́тся: и̑ я҆́кѡ по́ясъ, и̑́мже вы́нꙋ ѡ̑поя́сꙋется. Се́ дѣ́ло ѡ̑болга́ющихъ мя̀ оу҆ Гдⷭ҇а, и̑ глаго́лющихъ лꙋка̑вая на дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀. И̑ ты́, Гдⷭ҇и, Гдⷭ҇и, сотвори́ со мно́ю и̑́мене ра́ди твоегѡ̀: я҆́кѡ бл҃га ми́лость твоя̀. И̑зба́ви мя̀, я҆́кѡ ни́щъ и̑ оу҆бо́гъ є҆́смь а҆́зъ: и̑ се́рдце моѐ смяте́ся въ мнѣ̀. Ꙗ҆́кѡ сѣ́нь є҆гда̀ оу҆клони́тся, ѿя́хся: сотрясо́хся я҆́кѡ прꙋ́зи. Колѣ́на моя̑ и̑знемого́ста ѿ поста̀, и̑ пло́ть моя̀ и̑змѣни́ся є҆ле́я ра́ди. И̑ а҆́зъ бы́хъ поноше́нїе и̑̀мъ: ви́дѣша мя̀, покива́ша глава́ми свои́ми. Помози́ ми, Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е мо́й, и̑ сп҃си́ мя по мл҃ти твое́й. И̑ да разꙋмѣ́ютъ, я҆́кѡ рꙋка̀ твоя̀ сїя̀: и̑ ты́, Гдⷭ҇и, сотвори́лъ є҆сѝ ю̑̀. Прокленꙋ́тъ ті́и, и̑ ты́ благослови́ши. Восстаю́щїи на́ мя да постыдя́тся: ра́бъ же тво́й возвесели́тся. Да ѡ̑блекꙋ́тся ѡ̑болга́ющїи мя̀ въ срамо́тꙋ, и̑ да ѡ̑дѣ́ждꙋтся я҆́кѡ ѡ̑де́ждою стꙋдо́мъ свои́мъ. И̑сповѣ́мся Гдⷭ҇еви зѣло̀ оу҆сты̑ мои́ми, и̑ посредѣ̀ мно́гихъ восхвалю̀ є҆го̀. Ꙗ҆́кѡ предста̀ ѡ̑деснꙋ́ю оу҆бо́гагѡ, спастѝ ѿ гоня́щихъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: For He stood at the right hand of the poor, to save my soul from them that persecute me.
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃е, хвалы̀ моея̀ не премолчѝ: я҆́кѡ оу҆ста̀ грѣ́шнича, и̑ оу҆ста̀ льсти́ваго на́ мя ѡ̑тверзо́шася. Глаго́лаша на́ мя язы́комъ льсти́вымъ, и̑ словесы̀ ненави́стными ѡ̑быдо́ша мя̀: и̑ бра́шася со мно́ю тꙋ́не. Въ мѣ́сто любвѐ ѡ̑болга́хꙋ мя̀: а҆́зъ же мл҃твꙋ дѣ́яхъ. И̑ положи́ша на́ мя зла̑я за бл҃га̑я, и̑ не́нависть за возлюблє́нїе моѐ. Поста́ви на́нь грѣ́шника, и̑ дїа́волъ да ста́нетъ ѡ̑деснꙋ́ю є҆гѡ̀. Внегда̀ сꙋди́ти є҆мꙋ̀, да и̑зы́йдетъ ѡ̑сꙋжде́нъ: и̑ мл҃тва є҆гѡ̀ бꙋ́ди въ грѣ́хъ. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ дні́е є҆гѡ̀ ма́ли, и̑ є҆пи́скопию є҆гѡ̀ да прїи́метъ и̑́нъ. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ сы́нове є҆гѡ̀ си́ри, и̑ жена̀ є҆гѡ̀ вдова̀. Дви́жащеся преселя́тся сы́нове є҆гѡ̀, и̑ да воспро́сятъ: да и̑згна́ни бꙋ́дꙋтъ и̑зъ домо́въ свои́хъ. Да взы́щетъ заимода́вецъ вся̑ є҆ли́ка сꙋ́ть є҆гѡ̀: и̑ да восхи́тятъ чꙋ́ждїи трꙋды̀ є҆гѡ̀. Да не бꙋ́детъ є҆мꙋ̀ застꙋ́пника, ниже́ да бꙋ́детъ оу҆щедря́яй сироты̑ є҆гѡ̀. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ ча̑да є҆гѡ̀ въ па́гꙋбꙋ: въ ро́дѣ є҆ди́номъ да потреби́тся и̑́мя є҆гѡ̀. Да воспомяне́тся беззако́нїе ѻ҆те́цъ є҆гѡ̀ пред Гдⷭ҇емъ, и̑ грѣ́хъ ма́тере є҆гѡ̀ да не ѡ̑чи́стится. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ проти́вꙋ Гдⷭ҇у вы́ну, и̑ да потреби́тся ѿ земля̀ па́мять и̑́хъ: зане́же не помянꙋ̀ сотвори́ти мл҃ть. И̑ погна̀ человѣ́ка ни́ща и̑ оу҆бо́га, и̑ смире́нна се́рдцемъ є҆́же оу҆мертви́ти. slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source: ...Живы́й въ по́мощи Вы́шнягѡ, въ кро́вѣ Бг҃а нбⷵнагѡ водвори́тся. Рече́тъ Гдⷭ҇еви: Застꙋ́пникъ мо́й є҆сѝ, и̑ прибѣ́жище моѐ, Бг҃ъ мо́й, и̑ оу҆пова́ю на́нь. Ꙗ҆́кѡ то́й и̑зба́витъ тя̀ ѿ сѣ́ти ло́вчи, и̑ ѿ словесѐ мяте́жна. Плещма̀ свои́ма ѡ̑сѣни́тъ тя̀, и̑ под крилѣ̀ є҆гѡ̀ надѣ́ешися: ѡ̑рꙋ́жїемъ ѡ̑бы́детъ тя̀ и̑́стина є҆гѡ̀: не оу҆бои́шися ѿ стра́ха но́щнагѡ, ѿ стрѣлы̀ летя́щїя во днѝ. ѿ ве́щи во тмѣ̀ преходя́щїя, ѿ сря́ща и̑ бѣ́са полꙋ́деннагѡ. slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source: ...Живы́й въ по́мощи Вы́шнягѡ, въ кро́вѣ Бг҃а нбⷵнагѡ водвори́тся. Рече́тъ Гдⷭ҇еви: Застꙋ́пникъ мо́й є҆сѝ, и̑ прибѣ́жище моѐ, Бг҃ъ мо́й, и̑ оу҆пова́ю на́нь. Ꙗ҆́кѡ то́й и̑зба́витъ тя̀ ѿ сѣ́ти ло́вчи, и̑ ѿ словесѐ мяте́жна. Ꙗ҆́кѡ ты́, Гдⷭ҇и, оу҆пова́нїе моѐ: Вы́шняго положи́лъ є҆сѝ прибѣ́жище твоѐ. Не прїи́детъ ктебѣ̀ зло̀, и̑ ра́на не прибли́жится тѣлесѝ твоемꙋ̀. Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́гг҃лѡмъ свои̑мъ заповѣ́сть ѡ̑ тебѣ̀, сохрани́ти тя̀ во всѣ́хъ пꙋте́хъ твои́хъ. На рꙋка́хъ во́змꙋтъ тя̀, да некогда̀ преткне́ши ѡ̑ ка́мень но́гꙋ твою̀. items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сїя̑ глаго́летъ Гдⷭ҇ь І҆ꋋде́ѡмъ: Лю́дїе моѝ, что̀ сотвори́хъ ва́мъ; и̑ли чи́мъ ва́съ смꙋти́хъ; слѣпца̀ ва́ша просвѣти́хъ, прокажє́нныя ѡ̑чи́стихъ, мꙋ́жа сꙋ́ща на ѻ҆́дрѣ и̑спра́вихъ. Лю́дїе моѝ, что̀ ва́мъ сотвори́хъ; и̑ли что́ ми возда́сте; за ма́ннꙋ, же́лчь: за во́дꙋ, ѻ҆́цетъ: за є҆́же люби́ти мя̀, ко Крⷭ҇тꙋ́ мя пригвозди́сте. Ктомꙋ̀ не терплю̀ про́чее: призовꙋ̀ моя̑ язы́ки, и̑ ѡ̑ни́ мя просла́вятъ со Ѻ҆ц҃е́мъ и̑ Дх҃омъ, и̑ а҆́зъ и̑̀мъ дарꙋ́ю живо́тъ вѣ́чный. (Два́жды).
items.english_cohort_translation: Thus says the Lord unto the Jews: "My people, what have I done unto thee? Or wherein have I grieved thee? Thy blind have I enlightened, thy lepers have I cleansed, the man lying upon his bed have I restored. My people, what have I done unto thee, and wherewith hast thou repaid Me? Instead of the manna, gall; instead of water, vinegar; instead of loving Me, to the Cross thou hast nailed Me! No longer will I endure you: I will call My Gentiles, and they shall glorify Me with the Father and the Spirit, and I will bestow upon them eternal life!"[^369]
items.slavonic_text: Сїя̑ глаго́летъ Гдⷭ҇ь І҆ꋋде́ѡмъ: Лю́дїе моѝ, что̀ сотвори́хъ ва́мъ; и̑ли чи́мъ ва́съ смꙋти́хъ; слѣпца̀ ва́ша просвѣти́хъ, прокажє́нныя ѡ̑чи́стихъ, мꙋ́жа сꙋ́ща на ѻ҆́дрѣ и̑спра́вихъ. Лю́дїе моѝ, что̀ ва́мъ сотвори́хъ; и̑ли что́ ми возда́сте; за ма́ннꙋ, же́лчь: за во́дꙋ, ѻ҆́цетъ: за є҆́же люби́ти мя̀, ко Крⷭ҇тꙋ́ мя пригвозди́сте. Ктомꙋ̀ не терплю̀ про́чее: призовꙋ̀ моя̑ язы́ки, и̑ ѡ̑ни́ мя просла́вятъ со Ѻ҆ц҃е́мъ и̑ Дх҃омъ, и̑ а҆́зъ и̑̀мъ дарꙋ́ю живо́тъ вѣ́чный. (Два́жды).
items.english_text: Thus says the Lord unto the Jews: "My people, what have I done unto thee? Or wherein have I grieved thee? Thy blind have I enlightened, thy lepers have I cleansed, the man lying upon his bed have I restored. My people, what have I done unto thee, and wherewith hast thou repaid Me? Instead of the manna, gall; instead of water, vinegar; instead of loving Me, to the Cross thou hast nailed Me! No longer will I endure you: I will call My Gentiles, and they shall glorify Me with the Father and the Spirit, and I will bestow upon them eternal life!"[^369]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те, хрїстоно́снїи лю́дїе, ви́димъ что̀ совѣща̀ І҆ꋋ́да преда́тель, со свяще́нники беззако́нными, на Сп҃са на́шего: дне́сь пови́нна сме́рти, безсме́ртнаго Сло́ва сотвори́ша, и̑ Пила́тꙋ преда́вше, на мѣ́стѣ ло́бнемъ распя́ша: и̑ сїя̑ стражда́ вопїя́ше Сп҃съ на́шъ, гля́: Ѡ҆ста́ви и̑̀мъ, Ѻ҆́ч҃е, грѣ́хъ се́й, да разꙋмѣ́ютъ язы́цы и̑зъ ме́ртвыхъ моѐ воскресе́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, ye Christ-bearing peoples, let us behold what Judas the traitor plotted with the lawless priests against our Savior! Today they rendered liable to death the immortal Word, and delivered Him to Pilate, having crucified Him at the Place of the Skull. And while suffering this, our Savior cried aloud, saying: "Father, forgive them this sin, that the Gentiles may know My resurrection from the dead!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the 5th hour of the day, they strike the small semantron, and we make a Litiya outside the monastery. And having returned, we sing the Third Hour, the Sixth, and the Ninth, with their Troparia, and with the Paremias, and with the Epistles, with the Gospels, and with the rest of their service. Likewise the Troparia are sung: that of the day and that of the Feast. The Kontakia of the day: "He Who for our sake was crucified...". At the Ninth Hour, after the Trisagion, the Reading of the day; then: "Cast us not off..."; after Our Father, Kontakion of the day: "He Who for our sake was crucified...", "Lord, have mercy" (40 times), and the Prayer: "O Master, Lord Jesus Christ...". Then the Beatitudes: "In Thy Kingdom remember us, O Lord, when Thou comest...". Rapidly all the chants: "Remember us, O Lord...", "The heavenly choir...", "I believe in one God...", "Forgive, remit...". After Our Father:*

items.office: Great and Holy Friday: Vespers

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кле́плютъ въ Вели́кое дре́во, и҆ събра́вшимся на́мъ въ Це́рковь, Начина́емъ Вече́рню. Наче́ншꙋ І҆ере́ю: Бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шъ: И҆ на́мъ, А҆ми́нь. Цр҃ю̀ нб҃ный: Тр҃то́е: по Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ: Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, в҃і. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Прїиди́те поклони́мся, г҃. Та́же Ѱал: Бл҃гослови душе моя Господа: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, г҃. Пое́мъ, Ек҃тенїю Вели́кꙋю. Ка́ѳїсмꙋ не гле́мъ. На Гдⷭ҇и възва́хъ: Поста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ, ѕ҃. И҆ Пое́мъ Ст҃ры самогла́сны. Гласъ, а҃.
items.english_cohort_translation: All creation was changed with fear, beholding Thee hanging upon the Cross, O Christ! The sun was darkened, and the foundations of the earth were shaken; all things suffered with the Creator of all: O Thou Who didst willingly endure for our sake, O Lord, glory to Thee! *(twice)*

Цр҃ю̀ нб҃ный: Тр҃то́е: по Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ: Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, в҃і. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Прїиди́те поклони́мся, г҃. Та́же Ѱал: Бл҃гослови душе моя Господа: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: А҆ллилꙋ́їа, г҃. Пое́мъ, Ек҃тенїю Вели́кꙋю. Ка́ѳїсмꙋ не гле́мъ. На Гдⷭ҇и възва́хъ: Поста́вимъ стїхѡ́въ, ѕ҃. И҆ Пое́мъ Ст҃ры самогла́сны. Гласъ, а҃.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вся̀ тва́рь и҆змѣня́шеся стра́хомъ, зря́щи тя̀ на Крⷭ҇тѣ́ ви́сима, Хрⷭ҇тѐ: со́лнце ѡ҆мрача́шеся, и҆ землѝ ѡ҆снова́нїя подвиза́шася, вся̀ сострада́хꙋ вся̑ Созда́вшемꙋ: во́лею на́съ дѣ́ля претерпѣ́вый, Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀. (в҃.)
items.english_cohort_translation: O lawless and transgressive people, why have ye meditated on vain things? Why have ye condemned to death the Life of all? A great marvel it is that the Creator of the world is delivered into the hands of the lawless, and the Lover of mankind is lifted up upon the Tree, that He may deliver the captives in Hades who cry aloud: O Long-suffering Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Лю́дїе злочести́вїи и҆ законопрестꙋ́пныи, вочто̀ поꙋчи́шася тще́тнымъ; вочто̀ жи́знь всѣ́ческихъ сме́рти ѡ҆сꙋди́ша; вели́е чꙋ́до, я҆́кѡ Зижди́тель мі́ра, въ рꙋ́цѣ беззако́нны предаетсѧ, и҆ на дре́во возвыша́етсѧ чл҃колю́бецъ! да и҆́же въ а҆́дѣ нꙋ́жники свободи́ зовꙋ́щыя: долготерпѣли́ве Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the spotless Virgin, beholding Thee, O Word, lifted up upon the Cross, lamenting with a Mother's inward grief, was wounded bitterly in heart, and groaning in agony from the depths of her soul, she tore her outstretched hair; therefore beating her breast, she cried out piteously: "Woe is me, O Divine Child! Woe is me, O Light of the world! Why hast Thou set from mine eyes, O Lamb of God?" Whereat the armies of the bodiless hosts, seized with trembling, cried aloud: "O Incomprehensible Lord, glory to Thee!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: На Дре́вѣ зря́щи повѣ́шаема, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, тебѐ всѣ́хъ Созда́теля и҆ Бг҃а, безсѣ́менно ро́ждшая тя̀, въпїя́ше го́рькѡ: Сы́нꙋ мо́й, гдѣ̀ добро́та за́йде зра́ка твоегѡ̀; не терплю̀ зрѣ́ти тя̀ непра́ведно распина́ема: потщи́ся оу҆́бѡ въста́ни, я҆́кѡ да ви́ждꙋ и҆ а҆́зъ твоѐ и҆зъ ме́ртвыхъ тридне́вное въскресе́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Beholding Thee hanging upon the Tree, O Christ, the Creator and God of all, she who bare Thee without seed cried bitterly: "O my Son, whither has the beauty of Thy countenance departed? I cannot endure to behold Thee unjustly crucified! Hasten therefore, arise, that I also may see Thy Resurrection from the dead on the third day!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь Вл҃ка тва́ри предстои́тъ Пїла́тꙋ, и҆ Крⷭ҇тꙋ́ предае́тся Зижди́тель всѣ́хъ: я҆́кѡ а҆́гнецъ приводи́мъ на заколе́нїе свои́мъ хотѣ́нїемъ, Гвоздмѝ пригвожда́ется, и҆ въ ре́бра пробода́ется, и҆ гꙋ́бою напая́ется Ма́ннꙋ ѡ҆дожди́вый, по лани́тѣ оу҆даря́ется И҆зба́витель мі́ра, и҆ ѡ҆ свои́хъ рабъ порꙋга́ется Созда́тель вся́ческихъ. Ѡ҆ Влдко чл҃колю́бїя! Ѡ҆ распина́ющихъ моля́ше своего̀ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, гл҃ѧ: Ѻ҆́ч҃е, ѡ҆ста́ви и҆̀мъ грѣ́хъ се́й, невѣ́дятъ бо беззако́ннїи, что̀ непра́ведное сътворя́ютъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the Master of creation stands before Pilate, and the Creator of all is delivered over to the Cross, led as a sheep to the slaughter by His own will; He is pierced with nails, and wounded in His side, and He Who rained down manna is given gall and vinegar with a sponge; the Redeemer of the world is struck upon the cheek, and the Fashioner of all is mocked by His own servants! O Master of love for mankind! For those who crucified Him He prayed unto His Father, saying: "Father, forgive them this sin, for the lawless know not what injustice they do!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆ ка́кѡ законопрестꙋ́пный собо́ръ, Цр҃я̀ тва́ри ѡ҆сꙋди́ на сме́рть, не оу҆стыдѣ́вся бл҃годѣя́нїя! я҆́же въпомина́я, преꙋтвержда́ше гла́гола к ни̑мъ, лю́дїе моѝ что̀ сътвори́хъ ва́мъ; не чꙋде́съ ли и҆спо́лни[хъ] І҆ꙋде́ю; не ме́ртвеца ли въскрѣси́[хъ] є҆ди́нѣмъ сло́вомъ; не вся́кꙋю ли болѣ́знь и҆сцѣли́хъ, и҆ недꙋ́гъ; что̀ оу҆́бѡ мѝ въздае́те; вочто̀ не по́мните мя; за и҆сцѣле́нїя, ра́ны ми наложи́сте; за живо́тъ, оу҆мерщвля́юще, распина́юще на дре́вѣ я҆́ко злодѣ́я бл҃годѣ́теля: я҆́ко законопрестꙋ́пна, законода́вца: я҆́ко ѡ҆сꙋжде́нника, всѣ́хъ Цр҃я: долготерпѣли́ве Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Oh, how the lawless assembly condemned the King of creation to death, without shame for His benefactions, which He recalled, confirming them: saying unto them: "O My people, what have I done unto you? Have I not filled Judea with wonders? Have I not raised the dead with a single word? Have I not healed every sickness and disease? What therefore do ye render unto Me? Why do ye not remember Me? For healings ye have laid wounds upon Me; for life ye put Me to death, crucifying upon the Tree as an evildoer your Benefactor, as a transgressor your Lawgiver, as a condemned criminal the King of all! O Long-suffering Lord, glory to Thee!"

items.season_or_tone: Great and Holy Friday: Vespers
items.day_or_date: Great and Holy Friday: Vespers
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стра́шна и҆ пресла́вна та́йна, дне́сь съдѣва́ема зри́тся: неосяза́емый оу҆держава́ется, вя́жется разрѣша́яй А҆да́ма ѿ кля́твы: и҆спыта́яй сердца̀ и҆ оу҆тро́бы, непра́ведно и҆спы́тꙋется: въ темни́цꙋ затворя́ется, бе́зднꙋ затвори́вый: Пїла́тꙋ предстои́тъ, є҆мꙋ́же тре́петомъ предстоя́тъ нб҃сныѧ Си́лы: заꙋша́ется рꙋко́ю созда́нїя, Созда́тель: на дре́во ѡ҆сꙋжда́ется, сꙋдя́й живы́мъ и҆ ме́ртвымъ: въ гро́бѣ заключа́ется, разори́тель а҆́да: вся̀ терпя́й ми́лосрдно, и҆ всѣ́хъ сп҃сы́й ѿ кля́твы, неѕло́биве Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: A fearful and marvelous mystery is seen accomplished today! He Who is intangible is held fast; He Who looses Adam from the curse is bound; He Who searches hearts and reins is unjustly tried; He Who shut up the abyss is shut up in prison; He stands before Pilate, before Whom the heavenly Hosts stand with trembling; the Creator is struck by the hand of the creature; He Who judges the living and the dead is condemned to the Tree; the Destroyer of Hades is enclosed in a tomb! O Thou Who endurest all things in Thy tender mercy, and hast saved all from the curse: O Gentle Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆гда̀ въ гро́бѣ но́вѣмъ за всѣ́хъ положи́лся є҆сѝ, И҆збави́телю всѣ́хъ, а҆́дъ всепосмѣя́телный, ви́дѣвъ тя оу҆жасе́ся, вере́и сотры́шася, сокрꙋши́шася вра́та, гро́би ѡ҆верзо́шася, ме́ртвїи въста́ша: тогда̀ А҆да́мъ бл҃годарнѡ ра́дꙋяся вопїя́ше ти: Сла́ва снисхожде́нїю твоемꙋ̀ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: When from the Tree Joseph of Arimathea took Thee down dead, the Life of all, he wrapped Thee, O Christ, with myrrh and a clean Plashchanytsia, and was moved by love to kiss Thy spotless Body with heart and lips; yet held in awe, he cried aloud unto Thee rejoicing: "Glory to Thy condescension, O Lover of mankind!"

items.english_cohort_translation:
*Verse:* The Lord is King, He is clothed with majesty. (Ps. 92:1 [LXX])
When in a new tomb Thou wast laid for all, O Redeemer of all, all-mocking Hades, beholding Thee, was dismayed; its bars were broken, its gates were shattered, the tombs were opened, the dead arose! Then Adam, rejoicing in thanksgiving, cried aloud unto Thee: "Glory to Thy condescension, O Lover of mankind!"

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* For He has established the world, which shall not be shaken. (Ps. 92:1 [LXX])
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆гда̀ въ гро́бѣ пло́тски хотя̀ заключе́нъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆стество́мъ Бж҃тва пребыва́яй неопи́санный и҆ неѡпредѣли́мый: сме́рти заключи́лъ є҆сѝ сокро́вища и҆ а҆́дова вся̑ же оу҆праздни́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ ца́рствїя: тогда̀ и҆ Сꙋббо́тꙋ Бж҃е́ственнаго бл҃гослове́нїя и҆ сла́вы, и҆ твоея̀ свѣ́тлости оу҆досто́илъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: When in the tomb Thou wast enclosed according to the flesh by Thine own will, remaining in the nature of Thy Godhead uncircumscribed and boundless: Thou didst shut up the treasuries of death, and didst despoil all the kingdoms of Hades, O Christ! Then didst Thou account the Sabbath worthy of Divine blessing and glory, and of Thy radiance!

items.english_cohort_translation:
*Verse:* Holiness befits Thine house, O Lord, unto length of days. (Ps. 92:5 [LXX])
When the hosts of heaven beheld Thee, O Christ, slandered by the lawless as a deceiver, they were struck with awe at Thine ineffable long-suffering, and at the stone of the tomb being sealed by those very hands that pierced Thine undefiled side; yet rejoicing at our salvation, they cried aloud: "Glory to Thy condescension, O Lover of mankind!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆гда̀ си́лы зря́хꙋ тя̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, я҆́кѡ леща̀ беззако́нны ѡ҆клевета́ема, оу҆жаса́хꙋся неизглаго́ланномꙋ долготерпѣ́нїю твоемꙋ̀, и҆ ка́мени гро́ба рꙋка́ма запечатлѣ́емомꙋ, и҆́миже твоя̑ нетлѣ́нная ре́бра прободо́ша; ѡ҆ спасе́нїемъ на́шемъ ра́дꙋющеся вопїя́хꙋ: сла́ва снисхожде́нїю твоемꙋ̀ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Taking Thee down from the Tree with Nicodemus, Joseph, who saw Thee dead, naked, and unburied, Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, took up a compassionate lamentation, and weeping, said: "Woe is me, O sweetest Jesus! Whom the sun, beholding a little while ago hanging upon the Cross, wrapped itself in darkness, and the earth was shaken with fear, and the veil of the temple was rent in twain! But lo, now I behold Thee, Who for my sake didst willingly accept death! How shall I bury Thee, O my God? Or with what Plashchanytsia shall I wrap Thee? With what hands shall I touch Thine undefiled Body? Or what hymns shall I sing unto Thy departure, O Compassionate One? I magnify Thy Passions, I praise Thy Burial with Thy Resurrection, crying: O Lord, glory to Thee!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ. Своего̀ А҆́гнца А҆́гница зря́щи, къ заколе́нїю вле́кома, послѣ́доваше Марїа просте́ртыми власы̀ со и҆нѣ́ми Жена́ми, си́це въпїю́щи: Ка́мѡ и҆де́ши Ча́до; чесо̀ ра́ди ско́рое тече́нїе соверша́еши; є҆да̀ дрꙋгі́й Бра́къ па́ки є҆́стъ въ Кана Галиле́а, и҆ та́мѡ ны́нѣ тщи́шися, да ѿ воды̀ и҆̀мъ вїно̀ сътвори́ши; и҆дꙋ́ ли с тобо́ю Ча́до, и҆ли́ па́че пождꙋ́ тебѐ; Да́ждь ми сло́во СЛО́ВЕ, не молча̀ мимоиди менѐ, чⷵтꙋю соблюды́й мя. Ты́ бо є҆сѝ Сн҃ъ и҆ Бг҃ъ мо́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* Beholding her own Lamb led to the slaughter, Mary followed with hair disheveled, together with the other women, crying aloud thus: "Whither goest Thou, O Child? For what cause dost Thou complete this swift course? Is there another marriage again in Cana of Galilee, and dost Thou now hasten thither to make wine for them from water? Shall I go with Thee, O Child, or shall I rather wait for Thee? Give me a word, O WORD, pass me not by in silence, Thou Who didst keep me pure! For Thou art my Son and my God!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въспою̀ млⷵдїе твоѐ чл҃колю́бче, и҆ покланя́юся бога́тствꙋ млⷵти твоея̀ Вл҃ко: созда́нїе бо своѐ хотя̀ сп҃ти, сме́рть подъя́лъ є҆сѝ, речѐ Пречⷵтая: но въскрⷵнїемъ твои́мъ Сп҃се поми́лꙋй всѣ́хъ на́съ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *The Paraecclesiarch strikes the heavy wooden board, and the great bell, and the iron semantron. And when we are gathered in the church, we sing MATINS. The Priest having begun: Blessed is our God; and we: Trisagion. After Our Father, the Priest: For Thine is the kingdom; and after the Amen: Lord, have mercy (12 times). And immediately: Glory to the Holy, Consubstantial, and Life-creating Trinity... And the Six Psalms are sung, beginning with: Glory to God in the highest... And after the Six Psalms, the Great Litany. At "God is the Lord":*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь. Гласъ, в҃. Бл҃гоѡбра́зный І҆ѡ́сифъ, съ ДРЕ́ВА сне́мъ Прⷵтое ТѢ́ЛО ТВОЀ, ПЛАЩЕНИ́ЦЕЮ чⷵтою ѡ҆бви́въ, и҆ воня́ми въ гро́бѣ но́вѣ Покры́въ Положѝ. (два́жды).
items.english_cohort_translation: The noble Joseph, taking down Thy spotless Body from the Tree, wrapped it in a clean Plashchanytsia and sweet spices, and laying it in a new tomb, closed it. *(twice)*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆гда̀ снизше́лъ є҆сѝ къ сме́рти ЖИВОТЀ безсме́ртный, тогда̀ а҆́дъ оу҆мертви́лъ є҆сѝ блиста́нїемъ Бж҃тва, є҆гда́ же и҆ оу҆ме́ршая ѿ преиспо́днихъ въскрѣси́лъ є҆сѝ, вся̑ Си́лы Нб҃ныя възыва́хꙋ: Живода́вче Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ Сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: When Thou didst descend unto death, O Life immortal, then didst Thou slay Hades with the brilliance of Thy Godhead; and when Thou didst also raise the dead from the nethermost parts, all the Hosts of heaven cried aloud: "O Giver of life, Christ our God, glory to Thee!"

The Priest having begun: Blessed is our God; and we: Trisagion. After Our Father, the Priest: For Thine is the kingdom; and after the Amen: Lord, have mercy (12 times). And immediately: Glory to the Holy, Consubstantial, and Life-creating Trinity... And the Six Psalms are sung, beginning with: Glory to God in the highest... And after the Six Psalms, the Great Litany. At "God is the Lord":*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Почто̀ Мѵ́ры съ млⷵтивными слеза́ми ѡ҆ ꙋ҆чн҃ца растворѧ́ете; блиста́ѧисѧ на гро́бѣ А҆́гг҃лъ Мѵроно́сицам вѣща́ше: ви́дите вы̀ Гро́бъ и҆ ꙋ҆разꙋмѣ́йте, сп҃съ бо въскрⷭ҇се ѿ гро́ба:. Бл҃женъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Very early the Myrrh-bearing women ran unto Thy tomb, O Savior, weeping; but an Angel stood before them and said: "The time for weeping has ceased, weep not; but announce the Resurrection unto the Apostles!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зѣло̀ ра́но, Мѵроно́сица теча́хꙋ къ Гро́бꙋ твоемꙋ̀ сп҃се рыда́юще, Но предста̀ к ни̑мъ А҆́гг҃лъ, и҆ речѐ: рыда́нїа вре́мѧ преста̀, не пла́читесѧ: въскрⷭ҇нїе же А҆пⷭ҇ломъ рцы́те:. Бл҃женъ є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The Myrrh-bearing women, arriving with myrrh at Thy tomb, O Savior, weeping, heard the Angel speaking unto them: "Why do ye reckon the Living One among the dead? For as God He is risen from the grave!"

items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Bearing the Giver of life, O Virgin, thou hast delivered Adam from sin, and granted joy unto Eve in place of sorrow; and He Who became incarnate of thee, God and Man, has restored unto life them that had fallen from it.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ. Гла́, а҃. Под: Гро́бъ тво́й сп҃се: Плащани́цею чⷵто́ю Тѣ́ло и҆спроси́въ ꙋ҆ Пила́та Мѵ́ромъ пома́зꙋетъ, и҆ полага́етъ І҆ѡ́сифъ в но́вомъ Гро́бѣ: тѣ́мже ꙋ҆́трѧнше Мѵроно́сица Жены̀, възопи́ша: Покажи намъ, ꙗ҆́коже прере́клъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇те Въскрⷭ҇нїе:. Сла́ва: Коне́цъ. И҆ нн҃ѣ:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 1. Podoben: "The soldiers guarding" (Гро́бъ тво́й сп҃се):*[^422] Having asked Pilate for the Body, Joseph wraps It in a clean Plashchanytsia, anoints It with sweet spices, and lays It in a new tomb. Therefore, early in the morning, the Myrrh-bearing women cried aloud: "Show unto us, as Thou hast foretold, O Christ, the Resurrection!"

Плащани́цею чⷵто́ю Тѣ́ло и҆спроси́въ ꙋ҆ Пила́та Мѵ́ромъ пома́зꙋетъ, и҆ полага́етъ І҆ѡ́сифъ в но́вомъ Гро́бѣ: тѣ́мже ꙋ҆́трѧнше Мѵроно́сица Жены̀, възопи́ша: Покажи намъ, ꙗ҆́коже прере́клъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇те Въскрⷭ҇нїе:. Сла́ва: Коне́цъ. И҆ нн҃ѣ:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *The Paraecclesiarch strikes the heavy wooden board, and the great bell, and the iron semantron. And when we are gathered in the church, we sing MATINS. The Priest having begun: Blessed is our God; and we: Trisagion. After Our Father, the Priest: For Thine is the kingdom; and after the Amen: Lord, have mercy (12 times). And immediately: Glory to the Holy, Consubstantial, and Life-creating Trinity... And the Six Psalms are sung, beginning with: Glory to God in the highest... And after the Six Psalms, the Great Litany. At "God is the Lord":*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Посе́мъ Чте́нїе в концы Толкованїѧ Е҆ѵлїа ѿ Матѳе́ѧ. Зача́ло, рд҃і. Въ ꙋ҆́трїй же дн҃ь є҆́же є҆́сть по Пѧтцѣ̀. Въскрⷭ҇нїе Хв҃о, Не гле́мъ, Но а҆́бїе Ѱало́мъ, н҃.
items.english_cohort_translation: The angelic choirs were astonished, beholding Him Who sits in the Father's bosom, how He is laid in a tomb as one dead, the Immortal One! Whom the angelic ranks encircle and glorify with the dead in Hades, as Creator and Lord.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Волно́ю Морско́ю скры́вшаго дре́вле, Гони́телѧ мꙋчи́телѧ: под земле́ю скры́ша сп҃се́нныхъ Дѣ́ти. но мы̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ Ѻ҆трокови́ца Гдⷭ҇ви пои́мъ, сла́вно бо просла́висѧ:. Припѣ́въ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да твоеѧ̀ сла́вы всѧ̑ и҆спо́лниши, съше́лъ є҆сѝ въ ни́жнѧѧ землѧ̀, ѿ тебе́ бо не съкры́сѧ съста́въ мо́й и҆́же въ А҆да́мѣ, и҆ погребе́нъ и҆стлѣ́вша мѧ̀ ѡ҆новлѧ́еши чл҃колю́бче:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* That Thou mightest fill all things with Thy glory, Thou didst descend into the nether parts of the earth; for my person which is in Adam was not hidden from Thee, and being buried, Thou dost renew me who was corrupted, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Просте́рлъ є҆сѝ на Дре́вѣ дла́ни своѝ Сп҃се, и҆ съвокꙋпи́лъ є҆сѝ дре́вле разстоѧ́щаѧсѧ, ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїемъ же Сп҃се є҆́же въ Плащани́ци и҆ въ Гро́бѣ, ѡ҆кова́нныѧ разрѣши́лъ є҆сѝ: нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ра́звѣ тебѐ чл҃колю́бче:.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Чл҃коꙋбі́йственно, но не Бг҃оꙋбі́йственно бы́сть прегрѣше́нїе А҆да́мово: а҆́ще бо и҆ пострада̀ твоѐ плотско́е сꙋщество̀, но бж҃тво̀ безстрⷵтно пребы́сть: тлѣ́нное же твоѐ на нетлѣ́нїе преве́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ нетлѣ́нныѧ жи́зни показа́лъ є҆сѝ и҆сто́чникъ въскрⷭ҇нїѧ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Adam's transgression was man-slaying, but not God-slaying; for though Thy bodily nature suffered, yet Thy Divinity remained impassible: and Thou hast transferred Thy corruptible part unto incorruption, and revealed the fountain of incorruptible life through Thy Resurrection!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Цр҃твꙋетъ а҆́дъ но невѣчнꙋ́етъ, над̾ ро́домъ чл҃чїи: ты́ бо положе́нъ въ гро́бѣ держа́вне, живонача́лною дла́нїю, сме́рти ключа̀ разве́рглъ є҆сѝ, и҆ проповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ и҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка тꙋ̀ спѧ́щымъ, и҆збавле́нїе нело́жное, бы́въ Сп҃се ме́ртвымъ первене́цъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Hades reigns, but does not endure eternally over the human race; for laid in the tomb, O Mighty One, with Thy life-originating palm Thou didst shatter the keys of death, and proclaim unto those who slept there from the ages a true deliverance, becoming the Firstborn of the dead, O Savior!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 6. Podoben: "He who closed the abyss" (Вкопне́ннаго):*[^431] He Who closed the abyss is beheld dead, wrapped in myrrh and a Plashchanytsia; the Immortal One is laid in a tomb as mortal. And the women came to anoint Him with sweet spices, weeping bitterly and crying aloud: "This is the most blessed Sabbath, wherein Christ has fallen asleep, to rise on the third day!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́КОСЪ. Съдержа́й всѧ̑ на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ вознесе́сѧ, и҆ рыда́етъ всѧ̀ тва́рь, того̀ видѧ́щи на́га ви́сѧща на Дре́вѣ, Со́лнце лꙋ́ча скры́, и҆ Звѣ́зды ѿложи́ша свѣ́тъ. Землѧ́ же съ мно́гимъ стра́хомъ поколеба́сѧ, и҆ Мо́ре побѣжѐ, и҆ Ка́менїа распаде́сѧ. Гро́би же мнѡ́зи ѿверзо́шасѧ, и҆ тѣлеса̀ въста́ша ст҃ы́хъ блиста́ющасѧ, а҆́дъ низꙋ̀ стенетъ, І҆ꙋде́е совѣ́тꙋютъ ѡ҆клевета́ти Хв҃о Въскрⷭ҇нїе, Жены́ же възыва́ютъ: Сїѧ̀ Сꙋббѡ́та є҆́сть пребл҃гослове́ннаѧ, въ не́йже Хс҃ ꙋ҆снꙋ́въ, въскрⷭ҇нетъ тридне́венъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* He Who holds all things was lifted up upon the Cross, and all creation laments, beholding Him hanging naked upon the Tree; the sun hid its beams, and the stars withdrew their light. The earth shook with great fear, the sea fled, and the rocks were split asunder. Many tombs were opened, and the bodies of the saints arose radiant; Hades groans below, the Jews take counsel to slander Christ's Resurrection, and the women cry aloud: "This is the most blessed Sabbath, wherein Christ has fallen asleep, to rise on the third day!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. И҆рмо́съ. Неизрече́нное чꙋ́до, въ Пе́щи и҆зба́вивый Препⷣбныѧ Дѣ́ти и҆з̾ пла́мене, въ Гро́бѣ ме́ртвъ без̾дыха́ненъ полага́етсѧ: на сп҃се́нїе на́мъ пою́щымъ, И҆зба́вителю Бж҃е бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ:.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Оу҆жасни́сѧ боѧ́сѧ Нб҃о, и҆ да подви́жатсѧ ѡ҆снова́нїа землѝ, се́ бо въ ме́ртвыхъ въмѣнѧ́етсѧ, въ вы́шнихъ живы́й, и҆ въ Гро́бѣ ма́лѣ полага́етсѧ: є҆го́же Дѣ́ти бл҃гослови́те, Сщ҃е́ннїи по́йте, Лю́дїе превозноси́те є҆го̀ въ вѣ́ки:. Тропа́рь.

items.preceding_stichos: Refrain:* Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Раздрꙋши́сѧ пречⷵтый Хра́мъ, па́дшꙋю же въставлѧ́етъ скѵні́ю, А҆да́мꙋ бо пе́рвомꙋ вто́рыи, въ вы́шнихъ живы́й, сни́де да́же до а҆́довыхъ сокро́вищъ: є҆го́же дѣ́ти бл҃гослови́те, сщ҃е́ннїи по́йте, лю́дїе превъзносите въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The most pure temple is destroyed, but raises up the fallen tabernacle; for the Second Adam, Who dwells in the highest, descended even unto the subterranean treasures of Hades: Whom, ye youths, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Преста̀ де́рзость Оу҆чн҃комъ, А҆римаѳе́й же побѣжда́етъ І҆ѡ́сифъ: ме́ртва бо и҆ на́га зрѧ̀, на все́ми Бг҃а, про́ситъ и҆ погреба́етъ зовы́й: Дѣ́ти бл҃гослови́те, Сщ҃е́ннїи по́йте, людїе превозноси́те въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The boldness of the disciples has ceased, but Joseph of Arimathea excels; for beholding God over all dead and naked, he asks for Him and buries Him, crying: "Ye youths, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt unto all ages!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆ чуде́съ но́выхъ! ѽ бл҃гти! ѽ неизрече́ннаго терпѣ́нїѧ! во́лею бо по земле́ю печатлѣ́етсѧ, въ вы́шнихъ живы́й, и҆ льтце́мъ Бг҃ъ ѡ҆клевета́етсѧ: є҆го́же Дѣ́ти бл҃гослови́те, Сщ҃е́ннїи по́йте, людїе привъзно́сите въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* O new marvels! O goodness! O ineffable forbearance! For voluntarily He Who dwells in the highest is sealed beneath the earth, and God is slandered as a deceiver: Whom, ye youths, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supreme exalt unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да ра́дꙋетсѧ тва́рь, да веселѧ́тсѧ всѝ земноро́днїи: вра́гъ бо плѣне́нъ бы́сть а҆́дъ: съ Мѵ́ры Жены̀ да срѣта́ютъ, А҆да́ма со Є҆́ѵою ѿ тлѣ́нїа и҆збавлѧ́ѧ всеро́днѡ, и҆ въ тре́тїй де́нь въскрⷭ҇нꙋ:

items.season_or_tone: Great and Holy Saturday: Matins

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь съде́ржитъ Гро́бъ, съдержа́щаго дла́нїю тва́рь, покрыва́етъ Ка́мень, покры́вшаго добродѣ́телїю Нб҃са. Спи́тъ Живо́тъ, и҆ а҆́дъ трепе́щетъ, и҆ А҆да́мъ ѿ ꙋ҆́зъ раздрѣша́етсѧ. Сла́ва твое́мꙋ смотре́нїю, и҆́мже всѧ̑ съверши́въ поко́й вѣ́чный дарова́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, всест҃о́е и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ твоѐ Въскрⷭ҇нїе:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today a tomb holds Him Who holds creation in the palm of His hand; a stone covers Him Who covered the heavens with glory. Life sleeps, and Hades trembles, and Adam is loosed from bonds. Glory to Thy dispensation, whereby having accomplished all things, Thou hast granted us eternal rest, as God, and Thy most holy Resurrection from the dead!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Что̀ зри́мое видѣ́нїе; что̀ настоѧ́щїй поко́й; Цр҃ь вѣкѡ́мъ стра́сти ра́ди съверши́въ смотре́нїе, въ Гро́бѣ Сꙋббѡти́ствꙋетъ, но́вое на́мъ подаѧ̀ Сꙋббѡ́титко. томꙋ̀ възопи́имъ: въскрⷭ҇ни Бж҃е сꙋдѧ̀ землѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ты̀ Цр҃твꙋеши въ вѣ́ки, неизмѣ́рнꙋю и҆мѣ́ѧй ве́лїю ми́лость:.
items.english_cohort_translation: What is this sight beheld? What is this present rest? The King of the ages, having accomplished the dispensation through His Passion, keeps the Sabbath in the tomb, granting us a new Sabbath-rest! Unto Him let us cry aloud: "Arise, O God, judge the earth, for Thou reignest unto ages, having boundless and great mercy!"

items.day_or_date: Great and Holy Saturday: Matins
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те ви́ди Живо́тъ на́шъ въ Гро́бѣ лежа́щь, да въ гробѣ́хъ лежа́щыѧ ѡ҆живи́тъ. Прїиди́те дне́сь и҆́же и҆з̾ І҆ꙋ́ды спѧ́ще видѧ́ще, Прⷪ҇рочески є҆мꙋ̀ възопїи́: въсле́гъ ꙋ҆снꙋ́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ ле́въ, кто́ бо дви́гнетъ тѧ̀ Цр҃ю; но въста́ни Самовла́стнѡ, давы́й себѐ ѡ҆ на́съ во́лею, Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, let us behold our Life lying in the tomb, that He may give life unto them that lie in the tombs! Come, today, beholding Him Who sprang from Judah sleeping, let us prophetically cry aloud unto Him: "Thou hast couched, Thou hast slept as a lion; who shall rouse Thee up, O King? But arise by Thine own sovereign power, Who didst give Thyself up voluntarily for our sake! O Lord, glory to Thee!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Просѝ І҆ѡ́сифъ тѣ́ло І҆с҃ово, и҆ положѝ є҆̀ въ ново́мъ Свое́мъ Гро́бѣ: подоба́ше бо є҆мꙋ̀ и҆з̾ гро́ба ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆з̾ черто́га пройтѝ. сокрꙋши́вшыи держа́вꙋ сме́рти, и҆ ѿве́рзый вра́та ра́йскїѧ чл҃кѡмъ, Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀:.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́шнїй де́нь та́иннѡ, вели́кїй Мѡѷси́й проѡбразова́ше глѧ: И҆ бл҃ви Бг҃ъ де́нь се́дмый, сїа́ бо є҆́стъ бл҃гослове́ннаѧ Сꙋббѡ́та. Сїи́ є҆́стъ ꙋ҆покое́нїа де́нь, во́нже почѝ ѿ всѣ́хъ дѣ́лъ свои́хъ, Є҆диноро́дный Сн҃ъ Бж҃їй, ра́ди є҆́же на сме́рть Смотре́нїа Пло́тїю Сꙋббѡ́тствовавъ, и҆ в̾не́же бѣ̀ па́ки въꙁврати́высѧ, въскрⷭ҇нїа ра́ди, дарова́ намъ живо́тъ вѣ́чный, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бл҃гъ и҆ чл҃колю́бецъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the great Moses mystically foreshadowed, saying: "And God blessed the seventh day"; for this is the blessed Sabbath! This is the day of rest, whereon the Only-begotten Son of God rested from all His works, keeping the Sabbath in the flesh through the dispensation of death, and returning again unto what He was, through the Resurrection, has granted us eternal life, as the only good One and Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пребл҃женна є҆сѝ Бц҃е Дв҃о, въплоти́вшым бо сѧ и҆з̾ тебѐ, а҆́дъ плѣни́сѧ, А҆да́мъ призва́сѧ, кла́тва раздрѣши́сѧ, и҆ Є҆́ѵа свободи́сѧ. Сме́рть ꙋ҆мертви́сѧ, и҆ мы̀ ѡ҆жихо́мъ. Тѣ́мъ пою́ще вопїе́мъ: бл҃гослове́нъ Хс҃ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, и҆зво́ливый та́кѡ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos, for through Him Who was incarnate of thee, Hades is taken captive, Adam is recalled, the curse is annulled, and Eve is set free! Death is put to death, and we are quickened! Therefore singing we cry aloud: "Blessed is Christ our God, Who was thus well-pleased!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те ꙋ҆блажи́мъ І҆ѡ́сифа приснопа́мѧтнагѡ, въ но́щи къ Пїла́тꙋ прише́дша, и҆ Живота̀ всѣ́хъ и҆спроси́вша. Да́ждь мѝ Сего̀ стра́ннаго, и҆́же не и҆мѣ́етъ гдѣ̀ главы̀ поклони́ти: Да́ждь мѝ сего̀ стра́ннаго, є҆го́же ꙋ҆чени́къ лꙋка́вый на сме́рть предадѐ: Да́ждь мѝ сего̀ стра́ннаго, є҆го́же Мт҃и зрѧ́щи на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ви́сѧща, рыда́ющи вопїѧ́ше, и҆ Мт҃рски крича́ше: ѽ ꙋ҆вы́ мнѣ̀ Ча́до моѐ! ѽ ꙋ҆вы́ мнѣ̀ Свѣ́те мо́й! И҆ ꙋ҆тро́бо моѧ̀ возлю́бленнаѧ, Сѷмеѡ́номъ бо пререче́нное
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, let us bless Joseph of perpetual memory, who went unto Pilate by night and asked for the Life of all: "Give me this Stranger, Who has nowhere to lay His head! Give me this Stranger, Whom a deceitful disciple betrayed unto death! Give me this Stranger, Whom His Mother, beholding hanging upon the Cross, wailed with weeping and cried out in motherly fashion: 'Woe is me, my Child! Woe is me, my Light, and my beloved womb! For what was foretold by Simeon in the temple is come to pass: a sword has pierced my heart! But turn my weeping into the joy of Thy Resurrection!' We worship Thy Passion, O Christ! We worship Thy Passion, O Christ! We worship Thy Passion, O Christ, and Thy holy Resurrection!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съдержа́й конца̀, Гро́бомъ сѧ держа́тисѧ и҆зво́лилъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇те, да ѿ а҆́дова поглоще́нїѧ и҆зба́виши чл҃ч҃тво, и҆ въздви́гъ ѡ҆живи́ши на́съ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ безсме́ртный:. Сла́ва: Коне́цъ. И҆ нн҃ѣ: ви́нъ.

items.verbatim_book_heading: PART I: LAZARUS SATURDAY, PALM SUNDAY, AND GREAT AND HOLY PASSION WEEK :: We also attach the First Hour. And the Third, Sixth, and Ninth Hours we chant simply in the Narthex, together with the Beatitudes, at their proper time
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the second hour of the night, they strike the great bell and all the heavy bells. And we chant Matins according to the custom. At "God is the Lord," Troparia of the Day, Tone 2: "The noble Joseph...", once; "When Thou didst descend...", once. Glory: "The Myrrh-bearing women..."; Both now, of the Feast: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation..." And immediately we sing the Amomos in Tone 5. The Priest censes at the First Stasis, and likewise at the Second and Third, at the beginnings. At the First Stasis, the Refrain: "We magnify Thee, O Christ the Giver of life..." At the Second: "It is meet..." At the Third: "Every generation..." And at the end, we sing the Resurrectional Troparia: "The assembly of angels...", and the rest. Then the Little Litany and Sessional Hymns. After the second: "The soldiers guarding Thy tomb... wrapped It in a clean Plashchanytsia...", and the Reading of the Day. Then the Polyeleos, Sessional Hymn of the Feast, and Reading of the Feast. Hymns of Ascent: the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Proclaim the good news day by day..." "Let every breath..." Gospel of the Feast, from Luke, Section 4. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast, Tone 6: "Gabriel proclaims..." Canons: of the Feast with the Heirmos to 8, and of the Day with the Heirmos to 8. Katavasia: Heirmos of the Day, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos of the Day, Sessional Hymn of the Day, Glory, and both now, of the Feast, and Reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, Reading in the Prologue, and Synaxarion. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable than the Cherubim," but the Refrains of the Feast. "Holy is the Lord our God" in Tone 2. Exaposteilarion of the Feast, twice. At the Praises, Stichera Idiomela of the Day, 3, and of the Feast, 3. Then Sticheron Prosomoion of the Feast, Tone 8: "Let the heavens be glad...", with the verse: "Proclaim the good news day by day..." Glory, of the Day, Tone 6: "Joseph asked for the Body..." or "Today the great Moses mystically foreshadowed..." Both now: "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..." Great Doxology. The Priest vests in full priestly robes and makes the Entrance with the Holy Gospel Book, while we sing the Trisagion; and after the Trisagion, the Priest says: "Wisdom! Let us attend!" And we sing the Introit Troparion:*
items.office: We also attach the First Hour. And the Third, Sixth, and Ninth Hours we chant simply in the Narthex, together with the Beatitudes, at their proper time
items.section: At the second hour of the night, they strike the great bell and all the heavy bells. And we chant Matins according to the custom. At "God is the Lord," Troparia of the Day, Tone 2: "The noble Joseph...", once; "When Thou didst descend...", once. Glory: "The Myrrh-bearing women..."; Both now, of the Feast: "Today is the fountainhead of our salvation..." And immediately we sing the Amomos in Tone 5. The Priest censes at the First Stasis, and likewise at the Second and Third, at the beginnings. At the First Stasis, the Refrain: "We magnify Thee, O Christ the Giver of life..." At the Second: "It is meet..." At the Third: "Every generation..." And at the end, we sing the Resurrectional Troparia: "The assembly of angels...", and the rest. Then the Little Litany and Sessional Hymns. After the second: "The soldiers guarding Thy tomb... wrapped It in a clean Plashchanytsia...", and the Reading of the Day. Then the Polyeleos, Sessional Hymn of the Feast, and Reading of the Feast. Hymns of Ascent: the 1st Antiphon of Tone 4. Prokeimenon, Tone 4: "Proclaim the good news day by day..." "Let every breath..." Gospel of the Feast, from Luke, Section 4. Psalm 50. Sticheron of the Feast, Tone 6: "Gabriel proclaims..." Canons: of the Feast with the Heirmos to 8, and of the Day with the Heirmos to 8. Katavasia: Heirmos of the Day, both choirs together. After Ode 3, Kontakion and Ikos of the Day, Sessional Hymn of the Day, Glory, and both now, of the Feast, and Reading of the Feast. After Ode 6, Kontakion and Ikos of the Feast, Reading in the Prologue, and Synaxarion. At Ode 9, we do not sing "More honorable than the Cherubim," but the Refrains of the Feast. "Holy is the Lord our God" in Tone 2. Exaposteilarion of the Feast, twice. At the Praises, Stichera Idiomela of the Day, 3, and of the Feast, 3. Then Sticheron Prosomoion of the Feast, Tone 8: "Let the heavens be glad...", with the verse: "Proclaim the good news day by day..." Glory, of the Day, Tone 6: "Joseph asked for the Body..." or "Today the great Moses mystically foreshadowed..." Both now: "Most blessed art thou, O Virgin Theotokos..." Great Doxology. The Priest vests in full priestly robes and makes the Entrance with the Holy Gospel Book, while we sing the Trisagion; and after the Trisagion, the Priest says: "Wisdom! Let us attend!" And we sing the Introit Troparion

Та́же Прокименъ, А҆́плъ, А҆ллилꙋ́їа, Е҆ѵлїе дню. Ек҃тени, и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ. Ча́съ, а҃. Про́чїи же Часо́ве по́емъ въ свое́ вре́мѧ, и҆ на Часѣ́хъ Тропарь пра: и҆ дни: Кондаки же премѣнѧ́ѧ. и҆ Бл҃жена́: Ско́рѡ без̾ пѣ́нїѧ. По Ѻ҆́тче на́шъ: Ко́: пра: Ги помадꙋи и҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 2: "The noble Joseph..." Immediately the Priest: "Let us attend! Peace be unto all!" Then the Troparion of the Emperor, Tone 2: "Thou Who holdest the ends of the earth..." Prokeimenon and Old Testament Readings of the Day. Then the Prokeimenon, Epistle, Alleluia, and Gospel of the Day. Litany and Dismissal. First Hour. And the other Hours we chant at their proper time, and at the Hours the Troparion of the Feast and of the Day, alternating the Kontakia; and the Beatitudes swiftly without singing. After the Our Father, Kontakion of the Feast: "Lord, have mercy," and the Dismissal.*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вече́рнаѧ на́ша мл҃твы, прїимѝ ст҃ы́й Гн҃, и҆ пода́ждь намъ ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхѡ́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ты̀ є҆ди́нъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆вле́й въ Мі́рѣ въскре́нїе:.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь а҆́дъ стенѧ̀ въпїе́тъ: Оу҆́не мнѣ̀ бя́ше а҆́ще бы́хъ ѿ Мр҃їа ро́ждшагося не прїя́лъ: прише́дъ бо на мя̀ держа́вꙋ мою̀ раздрꙋшѝ, врата̀ мѣ́дѧнаѧ сътрѐ, дꙋ́ша я҆́же и҆мѣ́хъ пре́жде, Бг҃ъ сы́й въскресѝ, сла́ва Гдⷭ҇и Крⷵтꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ и҆ въскрⷵнїю твоемꙋ̀:. Два́жды.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today Hades groans aloud: "It were better for me had I not received the One born of Mary! For coming upon me, He destroyed my power, shattered the brazen gates, and being God, resurrected the souls which I formerly held. Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Thy Resurrection!" *(Twice).*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь а҆́дъ стенѧ̀ въпїе́тъ, раздрꙋши́ся моя̀ вла́сть, прїя́хъ ме́ртвеца я҆́кѡ є҆ди́наго ѿ ꙋ҆ме́ршихъ: Сего́же держа́ти ѿню́дь не могꙋ̀, но погꙋблѧ́ю и҆ сїя̀ и҆́миже ца́рствовахъ: а҆́зъ и҆мѣ́хъ ме́ртвыѧ ѿ вѣ́ка, но се́й всѣ́хъ въздвиза́етъ. Сла́ва Гдⷭ҇и Крⷵтꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ и҆ въскрⷵнїю твоемꙋ̀:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today Hades groans aloud: "My dominion is destroyed! I received a dead man as one of the deceased, yet Him I am completely unable to hold, but rather lose even those over whom I reigned. I possessed the dead from all eternity, but behold, He raises all! Glory, O Lord, to Thy Cross and Thy Resurrection!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́шнїй де́нь та́иннѡ, вели́кїй Мѡѷси́й проѡбразова́ше глѧ: И҆ бл҃вѝ Бг҃ъ де́нь седмы́й. Сїя́ бо є҆́стъ благослове́нная Сꙋббѡ́та, Се́й є҆́стъ Оу҆покое́нїя де́нь, во́ньже почѝ ѿ всѣ́хъ дѣ́лъ Свои́хъ, Є҆диноро́дный Сы́нъ Бж҃їй, ра́ди смотре́нїя є҆́же на сме́рть пло́тїю сꙋббо́тствовавъ, и҆ въ є҆́же бѣ̀, па́ки возвра́щся въскре́нїя ра́ди, дарова́ на живо́тъ вѣ́чный. Ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ бл҃гъ и҆ чл҃вѣколю́бецъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the great Moses mystically foreshadowed this day, saying: "And God blessed the seventh day." For this is the blessed Sabbath; this is the day of rest, on which the Only-begotten Son of God rested from all His works, keeping the Sabbath in the flesh according to the dispensation of death; and having returned again unto what He was through the Resurrection, He has granted us eternal life, for He alone is good and loves mankind.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всеми́рнꙋю сла́вꙋ ѿ чл҃вѣкъ прозя́бшꙋю, и҆ Влⷣкꙋ ро́ждшꙋю, Нб҃нꙋю две́рь въспои́мъ Мр҃їю Дв҃цꙋ, безпло́тнымъ пѣ́снь, и҆ вѣ́рнымъ ꙋ҆добре́нїе. Та́ бо я҆ви́ся Не́бо и҆ Хра́мъ Бж҃тва, та̀ прегражде́нїе вражды̀ раздрꙋши́вши, Ми́ръ въведѐ, и҆ Црⷵтвїе ѿве́рзе. Сїю̀ ꙋ҆́бѡ и҆мꙋ́ще вѣ́ры ꙋ҆твержде́нїе, Побо́рника и҆́мамы и҆з̾ нея̀ ро́ждшагося Гдⷭ҇а. Дерза́йте ꙋ҆́бѡ, дерза́йте лю́дїе Бж҃їи, и҆́бо то́й побѣди́тъ врагѝ я҆́кѡ Всеси́ленъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let us hymn the Virgin Mary, the glory of the whole world, who sprang forth from mankind and gave birth unto the Master, the heavenly portal, the song of the bodiless hosts, and the adornment of the faithful. For she appeared as heaven and the temple of the Godhead; she broke down the barrier of enmity, brought in peace, and opened the Kingdom. Therefore, having her as the firm foundation of our faith, we have as our defender the Lord Who was born of her. Be of good courage therefore, be of good courage, O people of God; for He will overcome the enemies, as He is almighty!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стр҃тїю твое́ю Хрⷵтѐ, стра́стїй свободи́хомся, и҆ въскрⷵнїемъ твои́мъ и҆з̾ нетлѣ́нїа и҆збы́хомъ, Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀:.

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* The Lord reigns, He is clothed with majesty!
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да възра́дꙋетсѧ тва́рь, Нб҃са да веселя́тсѧ, рꙋка́ми да въспле́щꙋтъ ꙗ҆зы́цы съ весе́лїемъ. Хе҃ бо Сп҃съ нашъ Крⷵтꙋ̀ пригвоздѝ грѣхѝ на́ша, и҆ сме́рть ꙋ҆мертви́въ живо́тъ намъ дарова̀, па́дшаго А҆да́ма всеро́дна въскр҃сивъ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃вколю́бецъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let creation rejoice, let the heavens be glad, let the nations clap their hands with gladness: for Christ our Savior has nailed our sins to the Cross, and having put death to death, has granted us life, raising the fallen Adam of all mankind, as He loves mankind.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Цр҃ю сы́й Нб҃ꙋ и҆ Землѝ непостижи́ме, во́лею распѧ́лся є҆сѝ за чл҃вѣколю́бїе. Є҆го́же А҆́дъ срѣ́тъ до́лѣ ѡ҆горчи́ся, и҆ Прв҃ныхъ Дꙋша̀ въспрїи́мше ра́довахꙋся, А҆да́мъ же ви́дѣвъ тя̀ Създа́телѧ въ преиспо́днихъ, въста̀. Ѡ҆ чꙋ́деси! ка́кѡ сме́рти вкꙋсѝ всѣ́хъ жи́знь; но ꙗ҆́коже и҆зво́лилъ є҆сѝ мі́ръ просвѣти́ти, вопїю́ща и҆ гл҃юща, въскресы́й и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀:.
items.english_cohort_translation: O King of heaven and earth, Incomprehensible One, Thou wast willingly crucified for the love of mankind! Hades, having met Thee below, was embittered, and the souls of the righteous, having received Thee, rejoiced; and Adam, seeing Thee the Creator in the nethermost parts, arose. O the marvel! How did the Life of all taste of death? But even as Thou wast pleased to enlighten the world, crying aloud and saying: O Thou Who art risen from the dead, Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Же́ны Мѵроно́сицы мѵ́ро носѧ́щїѧ, съ тща́нїемъ и҆ рыда́нїемъ Гро́бъ тво́й достиго́ша, и҆ не ѡ҆брѣ́тша Прчⷵтаго Тѣ́ла твоегѡ̀, ѿ А҆́гг҃ла же ꙋ҆вѣ́дѣвша но́вое и҆ пресла́вное чꙋ́до, А҆пⷭ҇ломъ гла́хꙋ, въскре́ Гдⷭ҇ь подаѧ́й мі́рови ве́лїю мл҃ть:.
items.english_cohort_translation: The Myrrh-bearing women, carrying myrrh, reached Thy Tomb with haste and lamentation; and not finding Thine immaculate Body, but learning of the new and most glorious marvel from the Angel, they said unto the Apostles: The Lord is risen, granting great mercy unto the world!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ и҆спо́лнися И҆са́їино прорече́нїе: Дв҃ою бо роди́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ по рождествѣ̀ ꙗ҆́коже пре́жде рождества пребыла є҆сѝ. Бг҃ъ бо бѣ̀ рожде́йся: тѣ́мже и҆ є҆стество новопресѣчеся. Но Ѽ Бг҃омт҃и, мл҃твъ твои́хъ рабъ въ твое́мъ Хра́мѣ приноси́мыхъ тебѣ̀ не пре́зри. Но ꙗ҆́кѡ Бл҃госе́рдаго свои́ма рꙋка́ма поне́сшаѧ, на твоѧ̑ мл҃ти́вники ꙋ҆милосе́рдисѧ, и҆ молѝ сп҃сти́ся дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Behold, the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: for as a Virgin thou didst give birth, and after giving birth thou didst remain even as thou wast before birth. For God was born: therefore nature was newly cleft. But, O Mother of God, despise not the prayers of thy servants offered unto thee in thy temple; but as thou didst hold the Tenderhearted One in thine arms, have compassion upon thy suppliants, and pray that our souls may be saved!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Не рыда́й Мт҃и, Хе҃ речѐ Бж҃твеннѡ, ро́ждшой, ꙋ҆́зриши бо мѧ па́ки въскр҃ша, и҆ свѣ́тлѡ тебѣ̀ є҆́же ра́дꙋйсѧ вѣща́юща, и҆ А҆да́ма съ Е҆́ввою въздви́гнꙋвша:. Сла́ва:

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́кѡ терплю̀ Ча́до ꙋ҆тро́бамъ болѣ́зни, ѻ҆́цѣ твоѐ лобыза́ющи, ꙋ҆глѧ́давшїи на дре́вѣ, ꙗ҆́же пре́жде зрѧ́хъ кра́сны доброто́ю сїѧ́ющїа: и҆ слѣпы́ просвѣща́ющїѧ, ма́нїемъ ти Бж҃веннымъ. И҆ нн҃:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* "How shall I endure, O Child, the pains of my womb, kissing Thy face which gazed from the Tree, which formerly I saw shining with beautiful comeliness, and enlightening the blind by Thy divine behest?"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Я҆́тъ бы́сть: Ка́кѡ ѡ҆тре́клся є҆сѝ Пе́тре Сп҃са, є҆го́же и҆сповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ Хрⷵта̀, Сн҃а Бг҃ꙋ живо́мꙋ, и҆ ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ на Дре́вѣ є҆ди́наго Распѧ́та, без̾ дыха́нїа и҆ без̾ ви́да, нижѐ Гро́бомъ Тѣ́ло скрꙑ́ти потща́лся є҆сѝ Ско́рѡ, чтⷵаѧ Мт҃рқи рыда́ющи вѣща́ше:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Held fast, but not consumed...* *Troparion:* "How hast thou denied the Savior, O Peter, Whom thou didst confess as Christ, the Son of the living God, and hast left Him alone upon the Tree, crucified, without breath and without form; neither hast thou made haste quickly to hide His Body in a tomb?" the pure Mother wept and spoke.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да́ждь ми Сло́во, Ѽ сладча́ишихъ Сло́ве ꙋ҆чт҃елꙋ, чтⷵаѧ съ пла́чемъ ти въпїѧ́ше: не терплю́ тя без̾ дыха́нїа положи́ти въ Гро́бѣ Сн҃ꙋ мо́й, въ ме́ртвыхъ свобо́дна: ви́ждь ꙗ҆́ко Своѝ Мт҃рь рыда́ющїи без̾ преста́ннѡ. Се́рдце бо моѐ про́йде ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе попалѧ́ющее:. Сла́ва:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* "Give me a word, O sweetest Word and Teacher!" the pure one cried unto Thee with weeping; "I cannot bear to lay Thee in the tomb without breath, O my Son, Who art free among the dead! Behold how Thine own Mother weeps without ceasing; for a burning sword has pierced my heart!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съдержа́й вся̀ на Крⷵтѣ̀ възнесе́ся, и҆ рыда́етъ вся̀ тва́рь, того̀ ви́дѧщи на́га ви́сѧща на Дре́вѣ: Со́лнце лꙋча̀ стѧ́гнꙋ, и҆ Звѣ́зды ѡ҆ложи́ша свѣ́тъ. Землѧ́ же съ мно́гимъ стра́хомъ поколе́бася, и҆ Мо́ре побѣ́же, и҆ Ка́менїе распаде́ся. Гро́би же мно́зи ѿве́рзошася, и҆ тѣлеса̀ въста́ша Ст҃ы́хъ блиста́ющися. Адъ ни́зꙋ сто́нетъ, І҆ꙋде́е съвѣщава́ютъ ѡ҆клевета́ти Хв҃о въскресе́нїе. Жены́ же въскли́цаютъ: Сїѧ̀ Сꙋббѡ́та є҆́стъ пребл҃гослове́ннаѧ, въ не́йже Хс҃ъ ꙋ҆снꙋ́въ, въскре́снетъ тридне́венъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* He Who holds all things was lifted up upon the Cross, and all creation laments, beholding Him hanging naked upon the Tree; the sun withdrew its rays, and the stars set their light; the earth with great fear was shaken, and the sea fled, and the rocks were cleft; many tombs were opened, and the bodies of the saints arose, shining radiantly; Hades groans below; the Jews take counsel to slander the Resurrection of Christ; while the women cry out: "This is the most blessed Sabbath, in which Christ, having fallen asleep, shall rise again on the third day!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тайносло́вникъ твое́гѡ рождества̀ Влⷣко Дв҃а, гл҃ющи, пла́каше го́рко. Оу́вы мнѣ̀ Гаврїи́ле, гдѐ бл҃говѣ́стїа; где́ ми є҆́же Ра́дꙋйсѧ; гдѐ є҆́же бл҃гослове́наѧ; и҆з̾ ꙋ҆тро́бы бо моеѧ̀ свѣ́тъ, ꙋ҆га́се на Крⷵтѣ̀:. И҆ нн҃ѣ:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The Virgin, speaking of the mystery of Thy birth, O Master, wept bitterly: "Woe is me, O Gabriel! Where are the glad tidings? Where is to me the 'Rejoice'? Where is the 'Blessed art thou'? For the Light from my womb has been quenched upon the Cross!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́кѡ беззако́ннїи лю́дїе, Ча́до сладча́йшее не пощадѣ́ша, на́га на дре́вѣ зрѧ́ще тѧ ви́сѧща, но ꙗ҆́кѡ ѕвѣ́рїе сꙋро́вїи прободо́ша Бж҃твенаѧ ре́бра твоѧ̑; ка́кѡ не распаде́ся тва́рь колѣблю́щися; но всѧ̑ в̾кꙋ́пѣ рꙋко́ю твое́ю Сло́ве съдержа́щеся:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* "How have the lawless people not spared Thee, O sweetest Child, seeing Thee hanging naked upon the Tree, but like wild beasts have pierced Thy divine side? How has creation not fallen apart in trembling? But all things together are held fast by Thy hand, O Word!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆жасни́ся Нб҃о и҆ Землѐ, и҆ съкры́и Со́лнце свѣ́та твое́гѡ зарѧ́. Се́ бо Свѣ́тъ въ тѣ́мѣ положи́выися, и҆з̾ бо́кꙋ мое́ю возсїѧ́выи Бг҃ъ є҆ди́нъ ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣ́тъ, на Дре́вѣ за́йде хотѧ̀ А҆да́ма въскр҃сити, без̾ дыха́нїа же держа́щи не терплю̀ болѣ́зни:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Be astonished, O heaven, in fear:* Be astonished, O heaven and earth, and hide, O sun, the rays of thy light! For behold, the Light has been placed in darkness, God Who shone forth from my womb as the only Light has set upon the Tree, desiring to resurrect Adam; and holding Him breathless, I cannot bear the pain!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́кѡ ти Сн҃ꙋ мо́й и҆ Бж҃е, Тѣ́ло пречⷵтое въ Гро́бѣ те́мнѣ покры́ю; гро́бы и҆стощи́вшагѡ; и҆ въскраща́юся тꙋ́нма рꙋка́ма не зарѧ́щи тѧ Ча́до, не терплю̀ ѡ҆тꙋпи́ти ѿ тебѐ съ Сн҃ꙋ мо́й, па́че же ꙋ҆́мрꙋ и҆ въ а҆́дъ сни́дꙋ:. Сла́ва:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* "How shall I cover Thy most pure Body in a dark tomb, O my Son and God, Who didst empty the tombs? And I shrink back with my hands, not looking upon Thee, O Child; I cannot bear to depart from Thee, O my Son, but rather will I die and go down into Hades!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слы́ши Нб҃о и҆ Землѐ, и҆ внуши́те Мт҃рнѧѧ моѧ̑ рыда́нїа. Се́ бо сꙋди́тель ва́шъ ѿ беззако́нныхъ рꙋ́къ распѧ́тся, и҆ Сѐ ꙗ҆ви́ся без̾ ви́да и҆ без̾ дыха́нїа на Мт҃рнихъ ло́нѣхъ, ѿ распе́ншыхъ закла́нъ бы́въ Созда́тель:. И҆ нн҃ѣ:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* "Hear, O heaven and earth, and give ear to my maternal lamentations! For behold, your Judge has been crucified by lawless hands, and lo, He appears without form and without breath upon His Mother's bosom, slain by those who crucified Him, the Creator!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆гда̀ вопїѧ́ше чⷵтаѧ, гла́са твое́гѡ бы слы́шала сла́дчаишаго Гл҃а, и҆ ꙋ҆́стнѣ є҆го̀ лѣ́пнѡ дви́жимѣ, и҆ ѻ҆́цѣ твоѝ свѣ́тлѡ ѕрѧ́щѣ, кра́снѣ добро́тою, ꙗ҆́кѡ да быхъ Сн҃ꙋ мо́й па́ки въскр҃ша тя видѣ́ла, и҆ ра́дости и҆спо́лнилася б̾ мѣ́сто го́ркихъ сле́зъ:.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: В̾мѣ́сто пеле́нъ Сн҃ꙋ мо́й, въ пона́вꙋ тя пови́хъ, в̾ мѣ́сто же ꙗ҆́слїй свѣ́те мо́й, въ гро́бѣ тя положꙋ̀ те́мнѣ, в̾ мѣ́сто же млека̀, слеза́ми покроплю̀ пречⷵти ти ꙋ҆́стнѣ, в̾ мѣ́сто же живо́тныхъ и҆ кра́сныхъ ти гл҃ъ, мр҃тво̀ без̾ рѣ́чи:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Weep not for Me, O Mother:* "Instead of swaddling bands, O my Son, I have wrapped Thee in a shroud; and instead of a manger, O my Light, I lay Thee in a dark tomb; and instead of milk, I sprinkle Thy most pure lips with tears; and instead of living and beautiful words, Thou art dead without speech!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Не рыда́й мене Мт҃и ꙗ҆́кѡ сме́ртна въ Гро́бѣ, є҆го́же въ пелена́хъ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃а видѣ́ла є҆сѝ, бл҃гоговѣ́йнѡ ѿ Волхвъ Пе́рскихъ покланѧ́ема. Во и҆́стиннѡмъ же А҆́гг҃лъ въз̾ѡпи́вшымъ, Сла́ва въскр҃шомꙋ, тебѣ̀ бо пе́рвѣе ꙗ҆влю́ся:. Сла́ва:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* "Weep not for Me, O Mother, seeing as mortal in a tomb Him Whom in swaddling bands thou didst behold as God, reverently worshipped by the Persian Magi, and when the Angels truly cried out: 'Glory to Him Who is risen!' For unto thee first will I appear!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆дѝ ча́до въ а҆́дъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ въскр҃сити съ А҆да́момъ, и҆̀же не А҆да́ма па́дши тле́н: а҆́з же мт҃рнѧ сле́зы точа́щи пре бра́ты прѧ́мѡ гро́ба твое́гѡ сѣжꙋ̀ Бж҃е мо́й, до́ндеже въскр҃снеши:. И҆ нн҃ѣ:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* "Go, O Child, into Hades, as God to resurrect with Adam those who through Adam fell into corruption; while I, shedding maternal tears before the gates right opposite Thy tomb, will sit, O my God, until Thou shalt rise again!"

items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* "O all-blessed Mother, weep not tears henceforth before the gates of the tomb; for I will arise and be glorified, and will radiantly proclaim unto thee 'Rejoice!', and having ascended into heaven, I will send unutterable joy!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ и҆сходѧ̀ и҆з̾ Це́ркве И҆гꙋ́менъ со І҆ере́и въ Притво́ръ Свѣ́щныи всѣ́ми пре́идꙋщи є҆мꙋ̀ Дїа́конѡмъ и҆ два̀ съ свѣща́ми: И҆ ѻ҆́ба ли́ка пою́ще Стїхи́рꙋ, Гла́съ, ѕ҃.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пое́тъ же И҆гꙋ́менъ, три́жды. И҆ Бра́тїа, три́жды. И҆ а҆́бїе И҆гꙋ́менъ глаго́летъ, Стїхъ, а҆. Да въскре́снетъ Бг҃ъ и҆ разы́дꙋ́тся вразѝ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ да бѣжа́тъ ѡ҆ лица̀ є҆гѡ̀ ненави́дѧщїи є҆гѡ̀.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Предвари́вша ꙋ҆́трѡ ꙗ҆́же со Мр҃їею, и҆ ѡ҆брѣ́тша ка́мень ѿваленъ ѿ Гро́ба, слы́шахꙋ ѿ А҆́гг҃ла: Въ свѣ́тѣ присносꙋ́щномъ сꙋ́щаго, съ ме́ртвыми не и҆щи́те ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃ка. Ви́дите гро́бныѧ пелены. Тецѣ́те и҆ мі́рꙋ проповѣди́те, ꙗ҆́кѡ въста̀ Гдⷭ҇ь, ꙋ҆мертви́выи сме́рть, ꙗ҆́кѡ Сн҃ъ є҆́стъ Бг҃а, сп҃сающагѡ ро́дъ чл҃вческїи:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ypakoë, Tone 4:*[^484] They who were with Mary came beforehand in the morning, and having found the stone rolled away from the tomb, heard from the Angel: "Why seek ye Him as a mortal among the dead Who is in the everlasting light? Behold the graveclothes! Run and proclaim unto the world that the Lord is risen, having slain death; for He is the Son of God, Who saves mankind!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сни́шелъ є҆сѝ въ преиспо́днѧѧ страны̀ земля̀, и҆ съкрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ верѣѧ̑ вѣ̑чныѧ, съдержа́щихъ свѧ́занныѧ Хе҃, и҆ тридне́венъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ ки́та І҆ѡ́на, въскр҃слъ є҆сѝ ѿ Гро́ба:.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́ще и҆ въ Гро́бъ сни́шелъ є҆сѝ без̾ сме́ртне, но а҆́довꙋ разрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ си́лꙋ, и҆ въскр҃слъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ Побѣди́тель Хе҃ Бж҃е: Жена́мъ Мѵроно́сицамъ ра́дость провѣща́вый, и҆ свои́мъ А҆пⷭ҇лѡмъ ми́ръ дарова́вый: па́дшымъ подаѧ́й въскресе́нїе:. Їкосъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Though Thou didst descend into the grave, O Immortal One, yet didst Thou destroy the power of Hades, and didst arise as Victor, O Christ God, proclaiming "Rejoice!" unto the Myrrh-bearing Women, and granting peace unto Thine Apostles, and bestowing resurrection upon the fallen!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆́же пре́жде со́лнца Со́лнце заше́дшее и҆ногда̀ въ Гро́бъ, предвари́ша къ ꙋ҆́трꙋ, възыска́ющѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ Днѐ Мѵроно́сица Дѣ́вы, и҆ дрꙋ́га къ дрꙋ́гѣй въпїѧ́хꙋ: Ѽ дрꙋ́гина, прїиди́те бо́нами пома́жемъ Тѣ́ло живоно́сное и҆ Погребе́ное, пло́ть въскр҃сившагѡ па́дшаго А҆да́ма лежа́щагѡ въ Гро́бѣ. И҆дѣ́мъ и҆ потщи́мся ꙗ҆́кѡже Волсвѝ, и҆ поклони́мся, и҆ принесе́мъ Мѵ́ра ꙗ҆́кѡ Да́ры, не въ Пелена́хъ, но въ Плащани́ци ѡ҆бви́томꙋ, и҆ пла́чимъ и҆ въз̾ѡпие́мъ: Ѽ Влⷣко въста́ни, па́дшымъ подая́й въскрⷵнїе:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* The Myrrh-bearing maidens anticipated the dawn, seeking as day the Sun that set before the sun in the tomb, and cried out one to another: "O companion women, come let us anoint with spices the life-bearing and buried Body, the flesh that raises fallen Adam lying in the tomb! Let us go, let us make haste like the Magi, and let us worship, and let us bring myrrh as gifts unto Him Who is wrapped not in swaddling clothes, but in a winding-sheet; and let us weep and cry out: 'O Master, arise, Who bestowest resurrection upon the fallen!'"

items.preceding_stichos: Verse: Praise Him upon the tuneful cymbals; praise Him upon the cymbals of jubilation: let every breath praise the Lord.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃олѣ́пное твоѐ смотре́нїе сла́вѧще, въпїе́мъ тѝ Хе҃: Роди́лся є҆сѝ ѿ Дв҃ы, и҆ неразлꙋ́ченъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀. Пострада́лъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃къ, и҆ во́лею претерпѣ́лъ распѧ́тїе, въскр҃слъ є҆сѝ ѡ҆ гро́ба ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆ черто́га и҆зше́дъ, да сп҃сеши мі́ръ, Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* Glorifying Thy divinely fitting dispensation, we cry unto Thee, O Christ: Thou wast born of the Virgin, yet wast undivided from the Father; Thou didst suffer as man, and of Thine own will didst endure the Cross; Thou didst rise from the tomb as from a bridal chamber, that Thou mightest save the world: O Lord, glory be to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: ПАСХА Сщ҃енная намъ дне́сь показа́ся, Па́сха Но́ва Ст҃а́я, Па́сха Та́инственая, Па́сха Всечтна́я, Па́сха Хс҃ И҆зба́витель, Па́сха Непоро́чная, Па́сха вели́кая, Па́сха вѣ́рнымъ, Па́сха две́ри ра́йскїя намъ ѿверза́ющая, Па́сха всѣ́хъ ѡ҆сщ҃а́ющая вѣ́рныхъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* A Pascha sacred has been revealed unto us today: a Pascha new and holy, a Pascha mystical, a Pascha all-venerable, a Pascha Christ the Redeemer, a Pascha blameless, a Pascha great, a Pascha for the faithful, a Pascha opening unto us the gates of Paradise, a Pascha sanctifying all the faithful!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те ѿ видѣ́нїа же́ны бл҃говѣ́стницы, и҆ Сїѡ́нꙋ рцы́те: Прїимѝ ѿ на́съ ра́дости бл҃говѣ́щенїа, въскрⷵнїа Хв҃а: красꙋ́йся ликꙋ́й, и҆ ра́дꙋйся І҆ерли́ме, Цр҃я̀ Ха̀ ꙋ҆зрѣ́въ и҆ гро́ба, ꙗ҆́кѡ Жениха̀ и҆схо́дяща.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* Come from the vision, O women bearers of good tidings, and say unto Zion: Receive from us the glad tidings of joy, of Christ's Resurrection! Exult, leap for joy, and be glad, O Jerusalem, beholding Christ the King coming forth from the tomb like a Bridegroom!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мѵроно́сица же́ны, зѣлѡ̀ ра́но предста́вша Гро́бꙋ Живода́вца, ѡ҆брѣто́ша А҆́ггла на Ка́мени сѣ́дяща, и҆ то́й провѣща́въ и҆̀мъ, си́це гла́ше: Что̀ и҆́щете Жива́го съ ме́ртвыми; что̀ пла́чете Нетлѣ́ннаго въ тлѣ̀; ше́дша проповѣ́дите Оу҆ченикѡмъ є҆гѡ̀:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* The myrrh-bearing women, arriving very early at the tomb of the Giver of Life, found an Angel sitting upon the stone; and he, addressing them, spoke thus: "Why seek ye the Living among the dead? Why weep ye for the Incorruptible in corruption? Go, proclaim unto His disciples!"

items.preceding_stichos: Verse: This is the day which the Lord hath made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́сха кра́сная, Па́сха Гдⷭ҇ня Па́сха, Па́сха всечⷵтнаѧ на́мъ возсїѧ̀. Па́сха Ра́достїю, дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́га прїиме́мъ. Ѡ҆ Па́сха и҆збавле́нїе ско́рби, и҆́бо и҆ гро́ба дне́сь ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆ черто́га возсїя́въ Хс҃, же́ны ра́дости и҆спо́лни гла́я: проповѣ́дите А҆пⷭ҇толѡмъ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* A Pascha of delights, Pascha, the Lord's Pascha, an all-venerable Pascha has shone upon us! A Pascha, in joy let us embrace one another! O Pascha, ransom from sorrow: for today Christ, having shone forth from the tomb as from a bridal chamber, filled the women with joy, saying: "Proclaim unto the Apostles!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въскрⷵнїя де́нь, и҆ просвѣти́мся торжество́мъ, и҆ дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́га прїиме́мъ: рцы́мъ Бра́тїе, и҆ ненави́дящимъ на́съ, прости́мъ вся̑ въскрⷵнїемъ, и҆ та́кѡ въз̾ѡпїи́мъ: Хс҃ въскр҃се и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ, сме́ртїю сме́рть попра́въ, и҆ сꙋ́щымъ въ гробѣ́хъ живо́тъ дарова́въ:.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Sticheron:* It is the day of Resurrection, let us be radiant for the festival, and let us embrace one another! Let us say: "Brethren!" even unto them that hate us; let us forgive all things in the Resurrection, and thus let us cry out: Christ is risen from the dead, trampling down death by death, and upon those in the tombs bestowing life!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: По конци́ же сея̀ Ст҃ры, Пое́мъ Хс҃ въскр҃се и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ: мно́гажды. И҆ тогда̀ быва́етъ Цѣлова́нїе И҆гꙋменꙋ съ про́чими Сщ҃енники, и҆ Дїа́коны въ ст҃о́мъ Ѻ҆лтарѝ, Цѣлꙋ́ющими Е҆ѵлїе и҆ Крⷵтъ и҆ дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́га. По се́мъ взе́мъ И҆гꙋменъ ст҃о́е Е҆ѵлїе, Или́ Чⷵтный Крⷵтъ, и҆ ста́нетъ внѣ̀ прѐ Цр҃кими Двермѝ: сни́ми же и҆ всѝ Сщ҃енници є҆ли́ко и҆́хъ є҆́сть, и҆ Дїа́кони, взе́мше кі́иждо и҆́хъ сто́е Е҆ѵлїе и҆ и҆ны́е же чⷵтный Крⷵтъ, илѝ и҆ чⷵтныя И҆коны, по чи́нꙋ свое́мꙋ. И҆ ста́нꙋтъ вси ря́домъ ѿ десны́ѧ страны̀ И҆гꙋмена.
items.english_cohort_translation: *And at the conclusion of this Sticheron, we sing:* Christ is risen from the dead... *many times. And then takes place the Kiss of Peace by the Superior with the other Priests and Deacons in the holy sanctuary, venerating the Gospel, the Cross, and one another.[^494] After this the Superior takes the Holy Gospel, or the Precious Cross, and stands outside before the Holy Doors; and with them also all the Priests, as many as there are, and the Deacons, each having taken either the Holy Gospel, or the Precious Cross, or the venerable icons, according to their rank. And they all stand in a row on the right side of the Superior.*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ прихо́дятъ пре́жде чⷵтнѣ́йшїи Цр҃ко́вници, и҆ ста́рци є҆ди́нъ по є҆дино́мꙋ, и҆ ма́ло прекланя́ются прѐ настоя́телемъ, и҆ зна́менаетъ кое́гождо и҆́хъ, чⷵтнымъ Крⷵто́мъ, и҆ цѣлꙋ́ютъ ст҃о́е Е҆ѵлїе, илѝ чⷵтный Крⷵтъ є҆го́же держи́тъ И҆гꙋменъ, та́же и҆ сама́го И҆гꙋмена въ ꙋ҆ста̀ цѣлꙋ́ютъ, гл҃юще: Хс҃ въскр҃се: ѻ҆́номꙋ же ѿвѣща́ющꙋ, Въи́стиннꙋ въскр҃се. Пото́мъ же ѻ҆́бразꙋ и҆ про́чихъ Сщ҃енникѡвъ цѣлꙋ́ютъ. И҆ са́ми междꙋ́ собо́ю по своему чи́нꙋ. И҆ ста́вятъ ся ѿ Пресвѵ́теръ, по де́снои стра́нѣ ря́домъ. Та́же по ни́хъ, и҆ Мїря́не, и҆ Рабо́тници Монастырстїи, тако́жде цѣлова́нїа тво́рятъ, и҆ въ то́мже чи́нꙋ да ста́нꙋтъ, и҆ дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́га цѣлꙋ́юще. Да быва́етъ же посредѣ̀ всѣ́хъ, въ всѣ́хъ ве́лїе Молча́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *And first the most venerable church-servants and elders come forward one by one, and bow slightly before the Superior; and he signs each of them with the Precious Cross, and they kiss the Holy Gospel, or the Precious Cross which the Superior holds, and then they kiss the Superior himself on the mouth, saying:* "Christ is risen!" *and he answers:* "Truly He is risen!" *Then they likewise venerate the icon and the other Priests, and among themselves according to their order. And they stand in a row to the right of the Presbyters. Then after them, the laymen and the monastery laborers likewise perform the kiss of peace, and stand in that same order, kissing one another. And in the midst of all, let there be great silence.*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆ по сконча́нїи же всѣ́хъ цѣлова́нїа, взе́мле Сщ҃енникъ ст҃о́е Е҆ѵлїе, ѿ рꙋкꙋ̀ И҆гꙋмена, и҆ полага́етъ на ст҃о́й Трапе́зѣ. Вси́мъ же бра́тїи стоя́щой, и҆ послꙋ́шающой съ внима́нїе, почита́етъ И҆гꙋменъ сло́во Златоꙋ́стагѡ ѿ ѻ҆лтаря̀ въ цр҃кихъ двере́хъ. И҆ гле́тъ, ѡ҆бра́щся на За́падъ лице́мъ: Па́влова ꙋ҆ста̀, Хв҃а ꙋ҆ста̀. Хв҃а же ꙋ҆ста̀, Па́влова ꙋ҆ста̀. Оу҆ста̀ Златоꙋ́стова, Хв҃а и҆ Па́влова ꙋ҆ста̀. Та́же гле́тъ сїѐ:
items.english_cohort_translation: *And at the conclusion of the kiss of peace of all, the Priest takes the Holy Gospel from the hands of the Superior, and places it upon the Holy Table. And while all the brethren stand and listen attentively, the Superior reads the homily of Chrysostom from the sanctuary in the Royal Doors. And turning his face to the West, he says:[^495]* "Paul's mouth is Christ's mouth; and Christ's mouth is Paul's mouth; the mouth of Chrysostom is the mouth of Christ and Paul." *Then he says this:*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въскрⷵнїе Хв҃о ви́дѣвше, поклони́мся ст҃о́мꙋ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ, І҆с҃ꙋ є҆ди́номꙋ безгрѣ́шномꙋ. Крⷵтꙋ̀ твое́мꙋ покланя́емъ ся Хе҃, и҆ ст҃о́е въскрⷵнїе твоѐ пое́мъ и҆ сла́вимъ: ты́ бо є҆сѝ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, ра́звѣ тебе и҆на́го не зна́емъ, И҆́мя твоѐ нарица́емъ. Прїиди́те вси вѣ́рнїи поклони́мъ ся Ст҃о́мꙋ Хв҃ꙋ въскрⷵнїю. се́ бо прїи́де Крⷵта ра́ди ра́дость всемꙋ̀ мі́рꙋ. всегда̀ бл҃гословя́ще Гдⷭ҇а поимъ въскрⷵнїе є҆гѡ̀: Распѧ́тїе бо претерпѣ́въ сме́ртїю сме́рть раздрꙋши́:. Та́же Ѵ҆пакоѝ, д҃.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the holy Lord Jesus, the only sinless One. We venerate Thy Cross, O Christ, and Thy holy Resurrection we hymn and glorify: for Thou art our God, apart from Thee we know no other, we call upon Thy Name. Come, all ye faithful, let us worship Christ's holy Resurrection, for behold, through the Cross joy hath come into all the world! Always blessing the Lord, let us praise His Resurrection: for having endured the Cross, He destroyed death by death!
items.slavonic_text: Въскрⷵнїе Хв҃о ви́дѣвше, поклони́мся ст҃о́мꙋ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ, І҆с҃ꙋ є҆ди́номꙋ безгрѣ́шномꙋ. Прїиди́те вси вѣ́рнїи поклони́мъ ся Ст҃о́мꙋ Хв҃ꙋ въскрⷵнїю. се́ бо прїи́де Крⷵта ра́ди ра́дость всемꙋ̀ мі́рꙋ. всегда̀ бл҃гословя́ще Гдⷭ҇а поимъ въскрⷵнїе є҆гѡ̀: Распѧ́тїе бо претерпѣ́въ сме́ртїю сме́рть раздрꙋши́:. Та́же Ѵ҆пакоѝ, д҃.
items.english_text: Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ, let us worship the holy Lord Jesus, the only sinless One. We venerate Thy Cross, O Christ, and Thy holy Resurrection we hymn and glorify: for Thou art our God, apart from Thee we know no other, we call upon Thy Name. Come, all ye faithful, let us worship Christ's holy Resurrection, for behold, through the Cross joy hath come into all the world! Always blessing the Lord, let us praise His Resurrection: for having endured the Cross, He destroyed death by death!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Предвари́вша ꙋ҆́трѡ ꙗ҆̀же ѡ҆ Мр҃їею, и҆ ѡ҆брѣ́тша Ка́мень ѡ҆ва́ленъ ѿ Гро́ба, слы́шахꙋ ѿ А҆́гг҃ла: и҆́же въ свѣ́тѣ присносꙋ́щномъ сꙋ́щаго, съ ме́ртвыми не и҆щи́те ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃ка. Ви́дите Гро́бныѧ пелена́. Тецѣ́те и҆ мі́рꙋ проповѣ́дите ꙗ҆́кѡ въста̀ Гдⷭ҇ь, ꙋ҆мертви́вый сме́рть: ꙗ҆́кѡ Сн҃ъ є҆́сть Бг҃а, сп҃са́ющагѡ ро́дъ чл҃вѣчкїи:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Anticipating the dawn, they that were with Mary, and finding the stone rolled away from the tomb, heard from the Angel: "Why seek ye with the dead as mortal Him Who abides in unapproachable light? Behold the winding-sheets of the tomb! Run and proclaim unto the world that the Lord is risen, slaying death: for He is the Son of God, Who saves the human race!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́ще и҆ въ Гро́бъ снизше́лъ є҆сѝ Безсме́ртне, но а҆́довꙋ раздрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ си́лꙋ, и҆ въскр҃слъ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ побѣди́тель Хе҃ Бж҃е, Жена́мъ Мѵроно́сицамъ ра́дость провѣща́вый, и҆ свои́мъ А҆пⷭ҇ло́мъ ми́ръ дарова́вый, па́дшымъ подаѧ́й въскресе́нїе:.
items.english_cohort_translation: Though Thou didst descend into the tomb, O Immortal, yet didst Thou destroy the power of Hades, and didst rise as Victor, O Christ God, proclaiming joy unto the Myrrh-bearing Women, and granting peace unto Thine Apostles, O Thou Who bestowest resurrection upon the fallen!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во Гро́бѣ Пло́тски, въ а҆́дѣ же съ Дш҃ею ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, въ Раи́ же съ Разбо́йникомъ, и҆ на Прⷵто́лѣ бы́лъ є҆сѝ Хе҃ съ Ѻ҆ц҃е́мъ и҆ Дхо́мъ, вся̑ исполнѧ́я Неѡпи́санный:.
items.english_cohort_translation: In the tomb bodily, in Hades with the soul as God, in Paradise with the thief, and on the throne wast Thou, O Christ, with the Father and the Spirit, filling all things, Thou Who art uncircumscribed!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мы́ же рече́мъ, А҆ми́нь. Та́же, Гле́мъ, Хс҃ въскр҃се: г҃. Сла́ва: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, г҃. Бл҃гослови. Та́же ѿпꙋ́стъ І҆ере́й, а҆ мы̀ ча́съ. items.english_cohort_translation: *And we say:* Amen. *Then we say:* Christ is risen... *(Thrice).* *Glory: Both now:* Lord, have mercy *(Thrice).* *Bless! Then the Priest gives the dismissal, and we conclude the Hour. items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́ЩЕ ЖЕ БУДЕТЪ ЛИТУРГЇА, А҆́постола и҆ Е҆ѵлїа, на Часовѣ́хъ не гле́мъ, Глю́тъ бо сѧ на Литꙋргі́и. Но то́чїю по тре́тїемъ ѿпѣ́ти в̾ Притво́рѣ, є҆гда̀ речѐ: Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, м҃. Та́же, И҆де́мъ и҆з̾ Притво́ра въ Це́рковь, Глю́ще: Чт҃нѣ́йшꙋю Херꙋві́мъ: И҆́, И҆́менемъ Гдⷭ҇нимъ бл҃гослови ѻ҆́ч҃е. Хотя́й же І҆ере́й пѣ́ти ст҃ꙋ́ю Литꙋргі́ю, ста́въ на сты́хъ двере́хъ, Гле́тъ: Бж҃е ꙋ҆ще́дри ны и҆ бл҃гослови ны, просвѣти́ лице твоѐ на ны̀ и҆ поми́лꙋй ны̀. Сла́ва: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, г҃. Бл҃ви: І҆ере́й ѿпꙋ́стъ, и҆ Проще́нїе. И҆ начина́етъ Бж҃твеннꙋю Литꙋргі́ю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *If, however, there is the Liturgy, the Apostle and Gospel are not read at the Hours, for they are read at the Liturgy. But only after chanting the third in the narthex, when he has said:* Lord, have mercy *(40 times).* *Then we go from the narthex into the church, saying:* More honorable than the Cherubim... *and* In the Name of the Lord, bless, father! *And the Priest desiring to sing the Holy Liturgy, standing before the Holy Doors, says:* God be gracious unto us and bless us, cause His face to shine upon us, and have mercy on us! *Glory: Both now:* Lord, have mercy *(Thrice).* *Bless! The Priest gives the dismissal and forgiveness, and begins the Divine Liturgy.*

items.english_cohort_translation: *It is fitting to know how the Moleben on Holy Pascha is chanted. The Priest says:* Blessed is our God! *And we say:* Amen. *Then the Priest:* Christ is risen... *(Thrice).* *And we at the last proclaim:* And upon those in the tombs bestowing life! *Then:* Christ is risen... *thrice on the kliros. The Priest saying the verses:* Let God arise... *Verse:* As smoke vanishes... *Verse:* So let the sinners perish... *Verse:* This is the day which the Lord hath made... *And we at each verse sing:* Christ is risen... *once. Then the Priest:* Glory: *And we:* Christ is risen... *Priest:* Both now: *We:* Christ is risen... *In place of Alleluia, the Priest says:* Christ is risen from the dead... *And we:* And upon those in the tombs bestowing life! *Then Glory: Both now: The Ypakoë:* Anticipating the dawn...

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Then the Kontakion, once:*
items.office: Paschal Hours for Holy Pascha and Throughout All Bright Week
items.season_or_tone: In this manner it is chanted for the Third Hour, for the Sixth, and for the Ninth Hour, and for Compline once, likewise also for the Midnight Office, even until Thomas Sunday
items.day_or_date: In this manner it is chanted for the Third Hour, for the Sixth, and for the Ninth Hour, and for Compline once, likewise also for the Midnight Office, even until Thomas Sunday
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆́ще ли хо́щеши приложи́ти Канѡ́нъ коемꙋ̀ Ст҃мꙋ, И҆ ты̀ та́кѡ пре́жде Тропа́рь Ст҃мꙋ, а҆'. Сла́ва: и҆ нн҃ѣ: Предвари́ша ꙋ҆́тро: Посе́мъ Е҆ктенѝ вели́каѧ. Ми́ромъ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помо́лимся. Та́же Канѡ́нъ Па́сцѣ, съ И҆рмосо́мъ на ѕ҃. Запѣ́въ, Хс҃ въскр҃се: Зрѝ: И҆ ст҃мꙋ а҆́ще бꙋ́детъ, на д҃. Въ Сре́дꙋ же и҆ въ Пѧто́къ свѣ́тлыѧ седми́ца, Пое́мъ Канѡ́нъ Па́сцѣ, на и҆', съ Бг҃ородичны є҆гѡ̀ того́же Канѡ́на, Два Тропарѧ̀. Катава́сїа, Спе́и людїѐ. По ѕ҃ пѣ́сни, Ко: и҆ И҆́косъ Па́сцѣ. Та́же Проки́менъ, Гла́съ, г҃. Се́й де́нь є҆го́же сотворѝ Гдⷭ҇ь. Ст҃: И҆сповѣ́даитеся Гдⷭ҇ви. Та́же Ст҃мꙋ, Проки́менъ, Е҆ѵлїе, ѡ҆ Лꙋкѝ, въскрⷵно, ѕ҃, Зача́ло, р҃дı. Пото́мъ Ст҃омꙋ. По ѳ҃ Пѣ́сни, за Досто́йно є҆́стъ, И҆рмо́съ, Свѣти́ся свѣти́ся. Та́же Хс҃ въскр҃се: г҃. Та́же Ѵ҆пакоѝ, Предвари́ша ꙋ҆́тро. Сла́ва: Тропа́рь ст҃мꙋ: И҆ нн҃ѣ, Во́: А҆́ще и҆ въ гро́бъ снизше́лъ є҆сѝ. Та́же Е҆ктенѝ, Поми́лꙋй на́съ Бж҃е: Посе́ І҆ере́й гле́тъ, Премꙋ́дрость. Мы́же, Хс҃ въскр҃се: Та́же І҆ере́й в̾ мѣ́стѡ Сла́ва тебѣ́ Хе҃ Бж҃е: Хс҃ въскр҃се и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ. И҆ мы̀, И҆ сꙋ́щымъ въ гробѣ́хъ живо́тъ дарова́. И҆ ѿпꙋ́стъ съ Крⷵто́мъ, гле́етъ си́це: Хс҃ въскр҃сый и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ сме́ртїю сме́рть попра́вый, и҆ сꙋ́щимъ въ гробѣ́хъ живо́тъ дарова́вый истинный Бг҃ъ на́шъ, мл҃твами прчⷵтыѧ своеѧ̀ мт҃ре. Пое́мъ възглаша́етъ, Хс҃ въскр҃се: Мы́ же ѿвѣща́емъ, Въи́стиннꙋ въскр҃се. И҆ па́ки пое́мъ Хс҃ въскр҃се: г҃. Та́же Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй, три́жды, съ пѣ́нїемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *If thou desirest to append a Canon to any Saint, thou dost likewise first say the Troparion of the Saint once. Glory: Both now:* Anticipating the dawn... *After this the Great Ektenia:* In peace let us pray to the Lord. *Then the Canon of Pascha, with the Heirmos to 6, with the refrain:* Christ is risen! *Note: And to the Saint, if there be one, to 4. On Wednesday and Friday of Bright Week, we chant the Canon of Pascha to 8, with the Theotokia of that same Canon, two troparia. Katavasia:* Let the people sing... *After Ode 6, the Kontakion and Ikos of Pascha. Then the Prokeimenon, Tone 3:* This is the day which the Lord hath made... *Verse:* Give thanks unto the Lord... *Then to the Saint, the Prokeimenon, Gospel from Luke, Resurrectional 6, Pericope 114. Then to the Saint. After Ode 9, in place of "It is truly meet", the Heirmos:* Shine, shine... *Then:* Christ is risen... *(Thrice).* *Then the Ypakoë:* Anticipating the dawn... *Glory: Troparion of the Saint: Both now, Kontakion:* Though Thou didst descend into the tomb... *Then the Ektenia:* Have mercy on us, O God... *After this the Priest says:* Wisdom! *We say:* Christ is risen... *Then the Priest in place of "Glory to Thee, O Christ God":* Christ is risen from the dead... *And we:* And upon those in the tombs bestowing life! *And the dismissal with the Cross, he says thus:* May Christ Who is risen from the dead, trampling down death by death, and upon those in the tombs bestowing life, our true God, through the intercessions of His all-pure Mother... *Then he proclaims:* Christ is risen! *And we answer:* Truly He is risen! *And again we chant:* Christ is risen... *(Thrice).* *Then:* Lord, have mercy *(Thrice), with chanting.*

И҆ мы̀, И҆ сꙋ́щымъ въ гробѣ́хъ живо́тъ дарова́.
